title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation

paragraphs.en: Abstract: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920 × \times 1080). Building on the video generation capabilities of Kandinsky 5.0, Kandinsky 6.0 Video employs a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that connects a pretrained video stream and a newly trained audio stream through bidirectional cross-attention for temporal and semantic alignment. Our continuous pretraining strategy first trains the audio stream from scratch on large-scale audio corpora and then trains both streams jointly on paired audio-video data while preserving unimodal fidelity; pretraining is followed by supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based post-training, and distillation. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality. To accelerate open research and deployment in multimedia generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要：我们推出了 Kandinsky 6.0 Video，这是一套用于同步生成文本到音频视频的基础扩散模型系列，包括 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite（3B 参数）和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro（29B 参数）。 两种模型均可生成包含唇部同步的 5 秒视频片段，并配有同步的 44 kHz 音频，支持文本到音频视频（T2AV）和图像到音频视频（I2AV）模式；内置的超分辨率模型可将输出分辨率提升至全高清（1920 × 1080）。 Kandinsky 6.0 Video 在 Kandinsky 5.0 的视频生成能力基础上，采用了一种双流 CrossDiT 架构，通过双向交叉注意力将预训练的视频流与新训练的音频流连接起来，以实现时间维度和语义上的对齐。 我们的持续预训练策略首先从大规模音频语料库中从头开始训练音频流，然后在对齐的音频视频数据上联合训练两个流，同时保持单模态的保真度；预训练之后还包括监督微调、基于强化学习的后训练以及蒸馏步骤。 在并排的人类评估中，Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro 明显优于其前代产品 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并且在语音质量方面尤其与领先的音频视频生成模型保持竞争力。 为了加速多媒体生成领域的开放研究和部署，我们基于 MIT 许可证发布了代码、模型检查点以及 diffusers 集成。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models [ 1 , 2 ] and flow matching methods [ 3 ] have proven effective for image synthesis [ 4 , 5 ] , offering fine detail and controllability. Extending them to video generation has required specialized architectures based on diffusion transformers (DiT) [ 6 ] and efficient spatio-temporal attention mechanisms that model temporal dependencies without prohibitive computational cost. Today, text-to-video (T2V) generation is represented by both closed-source systems (Sora [ 7 ] , Veo [ 8 ] ) and open-source models (HunyuanVideo [ 9 ] , Wan [ 10 ] , Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ] ). Kandinsky 5.0, in particular, combines the CrossDiT architecture with sparse NABLA attention [ 12 ] to achieve high efficiency with modest computational resources.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型 [ 1 , 2 ] 和流匹配方法 [ 3 ] 已被证明在图像合成 [ 4 , 5 ] 方面效果显著，能够提供精细的细节和可控性。 要将这些方法扩展到视频生成领域，需要基于扩散变换器（DiT）[ 6 ] 的专用架构以及高效的时空注意力机制，以在不产生过高计算成本的前提下建模时间依赖关系。 如今，文本到视频（T2V）生成既有闭源系统（Sora [ 7 ]、Veo [ 8 ]），也有开源模型（HunyuanVideo [ 9 ]、Wan [ 10 ]、Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ]）。 特别是，Kandinsky 5.0 将 CrossDiT 架构与稀疏 NABLA 注意力机制 [ 12 ] 相结合，从而以有限的计算资源实现了高效运行。

paragraphs.en: Generating video with synchronized audio (text-to-audio-video, T2AV) is substantially more challenging than generating either modality alone, as it requires semantic, temporal, and emotional consistency across modalities. Closed commercial systems such as Veo 3.1 [ 8 ] , Sora 2 [ 13 ] , and Wan 2.6 [ 10 ] achieve impressive results in unified audio-visual synthesis, including natural lip synchronization, dynamic background sounds, and multilingual speech. However, their source code is unavailable, hindering reproducibility and further research.
paragraphs.zh: 生成同步音频的视频（文本到音频视频，T2AV）比单独生成任一模态要困难得多，因为它要求各模态在语义、时间和情感上保持一致。 Veo 3.1 [ 8 ]、Sora 2 [ 13 ] 和 Wan 2.6 [ 10 ] 等封闭的商业系统在统一的视听合成方面取得了令人印象深刻的成果，包括自然的唇部同步、动态的背景声音和多语言语音。 然而，它们的源代码无法获取，这阻碍了可重复性和进一步的研究。

paragraphs.en: Recent works target joint audio-video generation within a single architecture, including ALIVE [ 14 ] , SyncFlow [ 15 ] , JavisDiT [ 16 ] , 3MDiT [ 17 ] , LTX-2 and its successor LTX-2.5 [ 18 ] , MiniMax-H3 [ 19 ] , and NVIDIA Cosmos 3 [ 20 ] . These models align the modalities temporally and semantically through mechanisms ranging from bidirectional cross-attention and hierarchical synchronization to flow-based architectures and omnimodal transformers. Considerable effort has also gone into scaling model size (to about 30B parameters and beyond), supporting additional input modes (image conditioning, multiple references), and developing standardized benchmarks for synchronization and quality, such as VABench [ 21 ] , T2AV-Compass [ 22 ] , and AVGen-Bench [ 23 ] . Despite this progress, open-source solutions still lag behind closed ones in clip duration, resolution, and synchronization accuracy, keeping this area highly active and open to new approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究致力于在单一架构内实现音频与视频的联合生成，包括 ALIVE [ 14 ]、SyncFlow [ 15 ]、JavisDiT [ 16 ]、3MDiT [ 17 ]、LTX-2 及其后续版本 LTX-2.5 [ 18 ]、MiniMax-H3 [ 19 ]，以及 NVIDIA Cosmos 3 [ 20 ]。 这些模型通过从双向交叉注意力和层级同步到基于流架构和全模态变换器的多种机制，在时间和语义层面实现多模态对齐。 研究团队也投入了大量精力来扩大模型规模（至约 300 亿参数甚至更多）、支持额外的输入模式（图像条件输入、多个参考输入），并开发用于同步和质量的标准化基准测试，例如 VABench [ 21 ]、T2AV-Compass [ 22 ] 和 AVGen-Bench [ 23 ]。 尽管取得了这些进展，开源方案在片段时长、分辨率和同步准确性方面仍落后于闭源方案，这使得该领域依然高度活跃，并持续开放给新的方法。

paragraphs.en: We introduce two models of different scale: Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, and operate in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes. Clips are generated in SD resolution and can be upscaled to Full-HD using a built-in super-resolution model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们推出了两种不同规模的模型：Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite（3B 参数）和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro（29B 参数）。 两者都能生成包含唇部同步的 5 秒视频片段，并配有同步的 44 kHz 音频，支持文本到音视频（T2AV）和图像到音视频（I2AV）两种模式。 视频片段以 SD 分辨率生成，并可通过内置的超分辨率模型提升至全高清。

sents.zh: 我们推出了两种不同规模的模型：Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite（3B 参数）和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro（29B 参数）。

sents.en: Both generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, and operate in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes.

sents.zh: 视频片段以 SD 分辨率生成，并可通过内置的超分辨率模型提升至全高清。

paragraphs.en: We employ a continuous pretraining strategy: the audio stream is first pretrained on large-scale audio corpora, then connected to the pretrained video stream through newly initialized cross-attention layers, and finally both streams are trained jointly on paired audio-video data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用了一种连续预训练策略：首先对音频流在大规模音频语料库上进行预训练，然后通过新初始化的交叉注意力层将其与预训练好的视频流连接起来，最后将两个流在配对的音视频数据上联合训练。

paragraphs.en: We describe a multi-stage post-training pipeline consisting of domain-specific supervised fine-tuning combined via model soup, reinforcement learning adapted from OmniNFT [ 24 ] , and two-stage distillation ( π \pi -Flow followed by adversarial refinement) to 10 function evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种多阶段的后训练流程，该流程包括通过模型融合（model soup）结合的多领域监督微调、改编自 OmniNFT [24] 的强化学习，以及两阶段蒸馏（π-Flow 随后进行对抗性优化），最终达到 10 次函数评估。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Kandinsky 6.0 Video on VABench [ 21 ] and in side-by-side human evaluation. It outperforms the open-source LTX 2.5 on most VABench metrics, clearly surpasses its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with proprietary systems, particularly in speech quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 VABench [ 21 ] 和人工对比评估中测试了 Kandinsky 6.0 Video。 它在大多数 VABench 指标上优于开源模型 LTX 2.5，明显超越其前代产品 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并且在语音质量方面仍能与专有系统保持竞争力。

sents.zh: 我们在 VABench [ 21 ] 和人工对比评估中测试了 Kandinsky 6.0 Video。

sents.en: It outperforms the open-source LTX 2.5 on most VABench metrics, clearly surpasses its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with proprietary systems, particularly in speech quality.

paragraphs.en: We release all model weights, source code, and integration with the diffusers library to the research community under the MIT license.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据 MIT 许可证，向研究界开放所有模型权重、源代码以及与 diffusers 库的集成。

paragraphs.en: The development of Kandinsky 6.0 Video required a substantial expansion of our data processing infrastructure and methodology. Building upon the foundations established for Kandinsky 5.0, we introduced a novel audio modality and constructed a comprehensive set of datasets for pretraining, fine-tuning, and downstream optimization. For pretraining, we prepared image (T2I), video (T2V), audio (T2A), joint audio-video (T2AV), and image-conditioned (I2AV) datasets to bootstrap the model across all modalities. For supervised fine-tuning, we developed dedicated SFT datasets for video and audio-visual tasks to enhance visual quality and achieve reliable audio-video synchronization. Additionally, we curated a Reinforcement Learning dataset for online optimisation, a Super-Resolution dataset to improve output detail, and an expanded Russian Cultural Code dataset to support culturally aware generation.
paragraphs.zh: Kandinsky 6.0 视频的开发要求我们对数据处理基础设施和方法论进行大规模扩展。 在 Kandinsky 5.0 奠定的基础之上，我们引入了一种新的音频模态，并构建了一套涵盖预训练、微调及下游优化的完整数据集。 在预训练阶段，我们准备了图像（T2I）、视频（T2V）、音频（T2A）、联合音频-视频（T2AV）以及图像条件生成（I2AV）数据集，以推动模型在所有模态上的初始训练。 在监督微调阶段，我们为视频和视听任务开发了专门的 SFT 数据集，以提升视觉质量并实现可靠的音频-视频同步。 此外，我们还整理了一个用于在线优化的强化学习数据集、一个用于提升输出细节的超分辨率数据集，以及一个扩展后的俄罗斯文化代码数据集，以支持具备文化意识的生成。

sents.zh: 在监督微调阶段，我们为视频和视听任务开发了专门的 SFT 数据集，以提升视觉质量并实现可靠的音频-视频同步。

sents.en: Additionally, we curated a Reinforcement Learning dataset for online optimisation, a Super-Resolution dataset to improve output detail, and an expanded Russian Cultural Code dataset to support culturally aware generation.
sents.zh: 此外，我们还整理了一个用于在线优化的强化学习数据集、一个用于提升输出细节的超分辨率数据集，以及一个扩展后的俄罗斯文化代码数据集，以支持具备文化意识的生成。

paragraphs.en: The core data processing infrastructure was upgraded: table partitioning and load-balancing mechanisms were enhanced to support concurrent operation of thousands of data processors, and vector indexes were extended to support clustering of audio-visual embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: 核心数据处理基础设施已升级：表分区和负载均衡机制得到增强，以支持数千个数据处理器并发运行，并且向量索引也进行了扩展，以支持对音视频嵌入进行聚类。

paragraphs.en: The Kandinsky T2I dataset for Kandinsky 6.0 Video is a 50-million-image subset of the Kandinsky 5.0 collection, re-annotated with a new captioner.
paragraphs.zh: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 的 Kandinsky T2I 数据集是 Kandinsky 5.0 集合中一个包含 5000 万张图像的子集，并使用新的注释工具进行了重新标注。

paragraphs.en: The subset used for Kandinsky 6.0 Video inherits the characteristics of the original Kandinsky 5.0 filtering pipeline. It consists of high-quality, diverse images with minimal text content: watermarked and text-heavy scenes were removed by the original filters, and perceptual deduplication [ 25 ] ensures broad visual variety. The dataset is balanced across object and scene categories (via YOLOv8 [ 26 ] and CLIP-based classifiers [ 27 ] ), and technical and aesthetic quality scores (TOPIQ [ 28 ] , Q-Align [ 29 ] ) guarantee a high standard. Complexity filtering (SAM 2 [ 30 ] ) retains visually rich and non-trivial compositions.
paragraphs.zh: 用于 Kandinsky 6.0 Video 的子集继承了原始 Kandinsky 5.0 过滤流程的特性。 它由高质量、多样化的图像组成，且文本内容极少：原始过滤器已移除了带水印和文本密集的场景，而感知去重 [ 25 ] 确保了丰富的视觉多样性。 该数据集在物体和场景类别上保持平衡（通过 YOLOv8 [ 26 ] 和基于 CLIP 的分类器 [ 27 ]），同时技术性和美学质量评分（TOPIQ [ 28 ]、Q-Align [ 29 ]）也保证了其高标准。 复杂度过滤（SAM 2 [ 30 ]）保留了视觉上丰富且非平凡的构图。

sents.en: The subset used for Kandinsky 6.0 Video inherits the characteristics of the original Kandinsky 5.0 filtering pipeline.
sents.zh: 用于 Kandinsky 6.0 Video 的子集继承了原始 Kandinsky 5.0 过滤流程的特性。

sents.en: It consists of high-quality, diverse images with minimal text content: watermarked and text-heavy scenes were removed by the original filters, and perceptual deduplication [ 25 ] ensures broad visual variety.
sents.zh: 它由高质量、多样化的图像组成，且文本内容极少：原始过滤器已移除了带水印和文本密集的场景，而感知去重 [ 25 ] 确保了丰富的视觉多样性。

sents.en: The dataset is balanced across object and scene categories (via YOLOv8 [ 26 ] and CLIP-based classifiers [ 27 ] ), and technical and aesthetic quality scores (TOPIQ [ 28 ] , Q-Align [ 29 ] ) guarantee a high standard.
sents.zh: 该数据集在物体和场景类别上保持平衡（通过 YOLOv8 [ 26 ] 和基于 CLIP 的分类器 [ 27 ]），同时技术性和美学质量评分（TOPIQ [ 28 ]、Q-Align [ 29 ]）也保证了其高标准。

sents.en: Complexity filtering (SAM 2 [ 30 ] ) retains visually rich and non-trivial compositions.
sents.zh: 复杂度过滤（SAM 2 [ 30 ]）保留了视觉上丰富且非平凡的构图。

paragraphs.en: Captions are generated using Qwen3-235B-A22B [ 31 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 图注是使用 Qwen3-235B-A22B [ 31 ] 生成的。

paragraphs.en: Descriptions are produced in both Russian and English .
paragraphs.zh: 描述将以俄语和英语两种语言生成。

paragraphs.en: Using Qwen3-30B-A3B , each description is rewritten into 4 levels of detail : long, medium, short, and shortest.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B，每个描述都被改写为 4 个详细程度级别：长、中、短和最短。

paragraphs.en: For Kandinsky 6.0 Video, we selected a subset of 20 million video scenes from the original Kandinsky 5.0 T2V collection. Additional filtering was applied to ensure quality and temporal consistency: clips with non-standard frame rates or containing scene transitions (detected via TransNetV2 [ 32 ] ) were discarded. All selected scenes were re-captioned with new, detailed captions.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Kandinsky 6.0 Video，我们从原始的 Kandinsky 5.0 T2V 集合中挑选了 2000 万个视频片段作为子集。 为了确保质量和时间一致性，我们进行了额外的筛选：帧率不符合标准或包含场景转换（通过 TransNetV2 [32] 检测）的片段均被舍弃。 所有选中的场景都重新添加了新的详细字幕。

sents.en: For Kandinsky 6.0 Video, we selected a subset of 20 million video scenes from the original Kandinsky 5.0 T2V collection.
sents.zh: 对于 Kandinsky 6.0 Video，我们从原始的 Kandinsky 5.0 T2V 集合中挑选了 2000 万个视频片段作为子集。

sents.en: Additional filtering was applied to ensure quality and temporal consistency: clips with non-standard frame rates or containing scene transitions (detected via TransNetV2 [ 32 ] ) were discarded.
sents.zh: 为了确保质量和时间一致性，我们进行了额外的筛选：帧率不符合标准或包含场景转换（通过 TransNetV2 [32] 检测）的片段均被舍弃。

sents.en: All selected scenes were re-captioned with new, detailed captions.
sents.zh: 所有选中的场景都重新添加了新的详细字幕。

paragraphs.en: The subset inherits the quality characteristics of the Kandinsky 5.0 pipeline while incorporating stricter temporal filtering. It consists of stable, single-scene clips without internal scene breaks, ensuring coherent visual narratives, and with standardized frame rates. Watermarks and text-heavy scenes are excluded, and perceptual deduplication ensures diverse content. Technical and aesthetic quality is guaranteed by DOVER [ 33 ] and Q-Align scores, while YOLOv8 and CLIP-based classifiers maintain balance across object and scene categories. Camera and object dynamics (VideoMAE [ 34 ] ) provide controlled motion diversity, and structural dynamics (MS-SSIM [ 35 ] ) ensures sufficient motion without excessive redundancy.
paragraphs.zh: 该子集继承了 Kandinsky 5.0 流程的质量特性，同时引入了更严格的时间过滤机制。 它由稳定的单场景片段组成，内部没有场景切换，从而确保视觉叙事的连贯性，并且具有标准化的帧率。 水印和文本密集的场景被排除在外，感知去重则确保了内容的多样性。 DOVER [ 33 ] 和 Q-Align 分数保障了技术和美学质量，而基于 YOLOv8 和 CLIP 的分类器则在物体和场景类别之间保持了平衡。 相机和物体动态（VideoMAE [ 34 ] ）提供了受控的运动多样性，而结构动态（MS-SSIM [ 35 ] ）则确保了足够的运动量且不过于冗余。

sents.en: The subset inherits the quality characteristics of the Kandinsky 5.0 pipeline while incorporating stricter temporal filtering.
sents.zh: 该子集继承了 Kandinsky 5.0 流程的质量特性，同时引入了更严格的时间过滤机制。

sents.zh: DOVER [ 33 ] 和 Q-Align 分数保障了技术和美学质量，而基于 YOLOv8 和 CLIP 的分类器则在物体和场景类别之间保持了平衡。

sents.en: Camera and object dynamics (VideoMAE [ 34 ] ) provide controlled motion diversity, and structural dynamics (MS-SSIM [ 35 ] ) ensures sufficient motion without excessive redundancy.
sents.zh: 相机和物体动态（VideoMAE [ 34 ] ）提供了受控的运动多样性，而结构动态（MS-SSIM [ 35 ] ）则确保了足够的运动量且不过于冗余。

paragraphs.en: For the video dataset, we applied the same captioning pipeline as for images. Captions are generated using Qwen3-235B-A22B in both Russian and English. Using Qwen3-30B-A3B , each description is rewritten into 4 levels of detail : long, medium, short, and shortest. Post-processing includes cleaning of introductory phrases and filtering of non-English and non-Russian characters.
paragraphs.zh: 对于视频数据集，我们采用了与图像相同的字幕生成流程。 字幕使用 Qwen3-235B-A22B 以俄语和英语两种语言生成。 使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B，每段描述都会被改写为 4 个详细程度级别：长、中、短和最短。 后处理包括清理开头短语以及过滤非英语和非俄语字符。

sents.en: For the video dataset, we applied the same captioning pipeline as for images.
sents.zh: 对于视频数据集，我们采用了与图像相同的字幕生成流程。

sents.en: Captions are generated using Qwen3-235B-A22B in both Russian and English.
sents.zh: 字幕使用 Qwen3-235B-A22B 以俄语和英语两种语言生成。

sents.en: Using Qwen3-30B-A3B , each description is rewritten into 4 levels of detail : long, medium, short, and shortest.
sents.zh: 使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B，每段描述都会被改写为 4 个详细程度级别：长、中、短和最短。

sents.en: Post-processing includes cleaning of introductory phrases and filtering of non-English and non-Russian characters.
sents.zh: 后处理包括清理开头短语以及过滤非英语和非俄语字符。

paragraphs.en: For pretraining the audio branch, we constructed a separate audio-only dataset Kandinsky T2A. It consists of 40 million audio tracks (5–20 seconds in length) extracted from the Kandinsky 5.0 video collection. Low-quality, silent, or corrupted tracks were discarded. Each track was annotated with a textual description of its audio content using Qwen3-30B-A3B , covering sounds, music, speech, and environmental acoustics. This dataset was used to bootstrap the audio modality before joint audio-video training.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对音频分支进行预训练，我们构建了一个独立的纯音频数据集 Kandinsky T2A。 该数据集包含 4000 万条音频轨道（时长为 5 至 20 秒），这些轨道是从 Kandinsky 5.0 视频集合中提取的。 低质量、无声或损坏的轨道均被舍弃。 每条轨道都使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B 标注了对其音频内容的文本描述，涵盖声音、音乐、语音和环境声学等内容。 在联合音频-视频训练之前，该数据集被用于初始化音频模态。

sents.en: For pretraining the audio branch, we constructed a separate audio-only dataset Kandinsky T2A.
sents.zh: 为了对音频分支进行预训练，我们构建了一个独立的纯音频数据集 Kandinsky T2A。

sents.en: It consists of 40 million audio tracks (5–20 seconds in length) extracted from the Kandinsky 5.0 video collection.
sents.zh: 该数据集包含 4000 万条音频轨道（时长为 5 至 20 秒），这些轨道是从 Kandinsky 5.0 视频集合中提取的。

sents.en: Low-quality, silent, or corrupted tracks were discarded.
sents.zh: 低质量、无声或损坏的轨道均被舍弃。

sents.en: Each track was annotated with a textual description of its audio content using Qwen3-30B-A3B , covering sounds, music, speech, and environmental acoustics.
sents.zh: 每条轨道都使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B 标注了对其音频内容的文本描述，涵盖声音、音乐、语音和环境声学等内容。

sents.en: This dataset was used to bootstrap the audio modality before joint audio-video training.
sents.zh: 在联合音频-视频训练之前，该数据集被用于初始化音频模态。

paragraphs.en: For training joint video generation with sound, we constructed the Kandinsky T2AV dataset. It consists of 7 million audio-video segments derived from the Kandinsky 5.0 video collection, filtered to ensure high-quality audio, meaningful audio–visual correspondence, and suitability for lip-sync modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 为了训练联合视频生成与声音模型，我们构建了 Kandinsky T2AV 数据集。 该数据集包含 700 万个音频-视频片段，这些片段源自 Kandinsky 5.0 视频集，并经过筛选以确保音频质量高、音画对应具有意义，且适合用于唇形同步建模。

sents.en: For training joint video generation with sound, we constructed the Kandinsky T2AV dataset.
sents.zh: 为了训练联合视频生成与声音模型，我们构建了 Kandinsky T2AV 数据集。

sents.en: It consists of 7 million audio-video segments derived from the Kandinsky 5.0 video collection, filtered to ensure high-quality audio, meaningful audio–visual correspondence, and suitability for lip-sync modeling.
sents.zh: 该数据集包含 700 万个音频-视频片段，这些片段源自 Kandinsky 5.0 视频集，并经过筛选以确保音频质量高、音画对应具有意义，且适合用于唇形同步建模。

paragraphs.en: The dataset was built by extracting audio tracks and applying a multi-stage filtering pipeline:
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集通过提取音频轨道并应用多阶段过滤流程构建而成：

paragraphs.en: Audio quality filters: Scenes with silent, corrupted, or low-quality audio tracks were discarded. Remaining clips have sufficient dynamic range, low clipping ratio, and adequate amplitude.
paragraphs.zh: 音频质量过滤器：包含静音、损坏或低质量音频轨道的场景被舍弃。 剩余的片段具有足够的动态范围、较低的削波比和适当的振幅。

sents.en: Audio quality filters: Scenes with silent, corrupted, or low-quality audio tracks were discarded.
sents.zh: 音频质量过滤器：包含静音、损坏或低质量音频轨道的场景被舍弃。

sents.en: Remaining clips have sufficient dynamic range, low clipping ratio, and adequate amplitude.
sents.zh: 剩余的片段具有足够的动态范围、较低的削波比和适当的振幅。

paragraphs.en: Lip-sync and synchronization filters: We applied two key metrics following the VABench benchmark [ 21 ] : Lip-Sync alignment score (LSA) and Desync. Clips with detected people were retained only if their LSA was at least 3 on a scale from 0 to 5, and clips with audio-visual events were retained only if Desync was below 0.1 on a scale from 0 to 1. Clips without visible faces were kept as they do not require lip-sync (about 25% of T2AV dataset). The combined filter ensures that retained clips either have good synchronization or contain no faces.
paragraphs.zh: 口型同步与同步过滤器：我们遵循 VABench 基准 [21]，应用了两个关键指标：口型同步对齐分数（LSA）和 Desync。 仅当检测到人物的片段其 LSA 在 0 到 5 的评分中至少为 3 时才会保留；仅当音视频事件片段的 Desync 在 0 到 1 的评分中低于 0.1 时才会保留。 没有可见面部的片段被保留，因为它们不需要口型同步（约占 T2AV 数据集的 25%）。 组合过滤器确保了保留的片段要么具有良好的同步性，要么不包含任何面部。

sents.en: Lip-sync and synchronization filters: We applied two key metrics following the VABench benchmark [ 21 ] : Lip-Sync alignment score (LSA) and Desync.
sents.zh: 口型同步与同步过滤器：我们遵循 VABench 基准 [21]，应用了两个关键指标：口型同步对齐分数（LSA）和 Desync。

sents.en: Clips with detected people were retained only if their LSA was at least 3 on a scale from 0 to 5, and clips with audio-visual events were retained only if Desync was below 0.1 on a scale from 0 to 1.
sents.zh: 仅当检测到人物的片段其 LSA 在 0 到 5 的评分中至少为 3 时才会保留；仅当音视频事件片段的 Desync 在 0 到 1 的评分中低于 0.1 时才会保留。

sents.en: Clips without visible faces were kept as they do not require lip-sync (about 25% of T2AV dataset).
sents.zh: 没有可见面部的片段被保留，因为它们不需要口型同步（约占 T2AV 数据集的 25%）。

sents.en: The combined filter ensures that retained clips either have good synchronization or contain no faces.
sents.zh: 组合过滤器确保了保留的片段要么具有良好的同步性，要么不包含任何面部。

paragraphs.en: Visual quality: The subset inherits the visual quality filters from the T2V pipeline (DOVER, Q-Align, CRAFT [ 36 ] , YOLOv8, and CLIP-based classifiers), ensuring high-resolution, text-free, and diverse visual content.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉质量：该子集继承了 T2V 流程中的视觉质量过滤器（DOVER、Q-Align、CRAFT [36]、YOLOv8 和基于 CLIP 的分类器），从而确保生成高分辨率、无文本且多样化的视觉内容。

paragraphs.en: For joint audio-video training, we generated comprehensive captions describing both visual and audio content. The process involved:
paragraphs.zh: 对于联合音频-视频训练，我们生成了同时描述视觉和音频内容的全面字幕。该过程包括：

paragraphs.en: Extracting speech transcripts using Gemma-4-E4B-it [ 37 ] , enclosed in <S>...<E> markers.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Gemma-4-E4B-it [ 37 ] 提取语音转录文本，并用 <S>...<E> 标记括起来。

paragraphs.en: Generating audio descriptions using Qwen3-30B-A3B, enclosed in <AUDCAP> ... <ENDAUDCAP> markers.
paragraphs.zh: 使用 Qwen3-30B-A3B 生成音频描述，内容包含在 <AUDCAP> ... <ENDAUDCAP> 标记中。

paragraphs.en: Combining these components and feeding them into Qwen3.5-35B-A3B [ 38 ] , which produced a unified detailed caption covering both the visual scene and its accompanying audio.
paragraphs.zh: 将这些组件结合并输入到 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B [ 38 ] 中，从而生成了一个涵盖视觉场景及其伴随音频的统一详细描述。

paragraphs.en: For the image-conditioned generation task (I2AV), we constructed a dedicated dataset. It consists of 116,000 specifically selected samples derived from the Kandinsky 5.0 video collection. Each sample is a pair: a starting frame (first frame of a video scene) and a corresponding combined caption describing both the visual content of that frame and the expected audio-visual continuation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于图像条件生成任务（I2AV），我们构建了一个专用数据集。 该数据集包含 116,000 个从 Kandinsky 5.0 视频集合中专门挑选的样本。 每个样本都是一对数据：一个起始帧（视频场景的第一帧）以及一个对应的组合描述，该描述既涵盖了该帧的视觉内容，也描述了预期的视听延续。

sents.en: For the image-conditioned generation task (I2AV), we constructed a dedicated dataset.
sents.zh: 对于图像条件生成任务（I2AV），我们构建了一个专用数据集。

sents.en: It consists of 116,000 specifically selected samples derived from the Kandinsky 5.0 video collection.
sents.zh: 该数据集包含 116,000 个从 Kandinsky 5.0 视频集合中专门挑选的样本。

sents.en: Each sample is a pair: a starting frame (first frame of a video scene) and a corresponding combined caption describing both the visual content of that frame and the expected audio-visual continuation.
sents.zh: 每个样本都是一对数据：一个起始帧（视频场景的第一帧）以及一个对应的组合描述，该描述既涵盖了该帧的视觉内容，也描述了预期的视听延续。

paragraphs.en: Captions were generated using a two-stage local pipeline. First, audio descriptions were produced using Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B [ 39 ] . Second, these audio descriptions, together with camera motion classification labels, were fed into Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to produce a unified video+audio caption. All captions were subsequently rewritten into four detail levels (long, medium, short, shortest) using a dedicated rewriter.
paragraphs.zh: 字幕是通过一个两阶段本地流程生成的。 首先，使用 Gemma-4-E4B-it 和 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B [ 39 ] 生成了音频描述。 其次，将这些音频描述与相机运动分类标签一同输入 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，以生成统一的视频+音频字幕。 随后，所有字幕都通过一个专门的改写工具被重写成四个详细程度级别（长、中、短、最短）。

sents.en: Captions were generated using a two-stage local pipeline.
sents.zh: 字幕是通过一个两阶段本地流程生成的。

sents.en: First, audio descriptions were produced using Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B [ 39 ] .
sents.zh: 首先，使用 Gemma-4-E4B-it 和 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B [ 39 ] 生成了音频描述。

sents.en: Second, these audio descriptions, together with camera motion classification labels, were fed into Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to produce a unified video+audio caption.
sents.zh: 其次，将这些音频描述与相机运动分类标签一同输入 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，以生成统一的视频+音频字幕。

sents.en: All captions were subsequently rewritten into four detail levels (long, medium, short, shortest) using a dedicated rewriter.
sents.zh: 随后，所有字幕都通过一个专门的改写工具被重写成四个详细程度级别（长、中、短、最短）。

paragraphs.en: The dataset underwent additional filtering applied to the starting frames to ensure semantic and technical suitability for image-conditioned generation. The selection criteria included:
paragraphs.zh: 该数据集对起始帧进行了额外筛选，以确保其语义和技术上适合图像条件生成。 筛选标准包括：

sents.en: The dataset underwent additional filtering applied to the starting frames to ensure semantic and technical suitability for image-conditioned generation.
sents.zh: 该数据集对起始帧进行了额外筛选，以确保其语义和技术上适合图像条件生成。

sents.en: The selection criteria included:
sents.zh: 筛选标准包括：

paragraphs.en: Zero-shot embedding quality (Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B [ 40 ] ): overall quality, sharpness, exposure, artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 零样本嵌入质量（Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B [ 40 ]）：整体质量、清晰度、曝光度、伪影。

paragraphs.en: No-reference image quality assessment (using PyIQA library [ 41 ] ): multiple metrics including clipiqa+, topiq_nr, musiq-koniq, dbcnn, qalign, niqe, brisque, ilniqe, pi, and others.
paragraphs.zh: 无参考图像质量评估（使用 PyIQA 库 [41]）：包括 clipiqa+、topiq_nr、musiq-koniq、dbcnn、qalign、niqe、brisque、ilniqe、pi 等多种指标。

paragraphs.en: Classical CV detectors : blur detection via variance of Laplacian.
paragraphs.zh: 经典计算机视觉检测器：通过拉普拉斯算子的方差进行模糊检测。

paragraphs.en: Semantic suitability for I2V : Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 42 ] verified that the frame represents a beginning or pause of an action (not a mid-action peak), that the main object is clearly visible and not cropped, and that the frame is not empty or transitional.
paragraphs.zh: I2V 的语义适配性：Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 42 ] 已验证该帧表示动作的开始或暂停（而非动作中的峰值），主要对象清晰可见且未被裁剪，并且该帧并非空白或过渡帧。

paragraphs.en: The filtering (union of all criteria) ensured that only high-quality, semantically appropriate starting frames were retained, resulting in a diverse and reliable dataset for both pretraining and subsequent fine-tuning stages.
paragraphs.zh: 筛选过程（所有标准的并集）确保了仅保留高质量且语义恰当的起始帧，从而为预训练和随后的微调阶段生成了一套多样化且可靠的数据集。

paragraphs.en: For supervised fine-tuning, we constructed two datasets: for video-only tasks and for audio-visual tasks. Both datasets share the same 11-domain taxonomy (see Table 1 ) and are used in a two-stage training procedure: Stage 1 focuses on visual quality enhancement, Stage 2 on audio-video synchronization and lip-sync.
paragraphs.zh: 在监督微调中，我们构建了两个数据集：一个用于纯视频任务，另一个用于视听任务。 这两个数据集共享相同的 11 个领域的分类体系（参见表 1），并用于一个两阶段训练流程：第一阶段专注于视觉质量提升，第二阶段则关注音频与视频的同步以及唇语同步。

sents.en: For supervised fine-tuning, we constructed two datasets: for video-only tasks and for audio-visual tasks.
sents.zh: 在监督微调中，我们构建了两个数据集：一个用于纯视频任务，另一个用于视听任务。

sents.en: Both datasets share the same 11-domain taxonomy (see Table 1 ) and are used in a two-stage training procedure: Stage 1 focuses on visual quality enhancement, Stage 2 on audio-video synchronization and lip-sync.
sents.zh: 这两个数据集共享相同的 11 个领域的分类体系（参见表 1），并用于一个两阶段训练流程：第一阶段专注于视觉质量提升，第二阶段则关注音频与视频的同步以及唇语同步。

paragraphs.en: The datasets were built with the following common pipeline:
paragraphs.zh: 数据集是使用以下通用流程构建的：

paragraphs.en: Technical quality filtering: Video scenes are filtered using DOVER, Q-Align, CRAFT, and motion dynamics models (same as in the main T2V pipeline). For audio, we apply Meta Audiobox Aesthetics [ 43 ] (production quality, complexity, content enjoyment, usefulness) and discard silent or corrupted tracks.
paragraphs.zh: 技术质量过滤：视频场景使用 DOVER、Q-Align、CRAFT 和运动动态模型进行过滤（与主 T2V 流程中的模型相同）。 对于音频，我们应用 Meta Audiobox Aesthetics [43]（制作质量、复杂性、内容趣味性、实用性），并丢弃无声或损坏的音轨。

sents.en: Technical quality filtering: Video scenes are filtered using DOVER, Q-Align, CRAFT, and motion dynamics models (same as in the main T2V pipeline).
sents.zh: 技术质量过滤：视频场景使用 DOVER、Q-Align、CRAFT 和运动动态模型进行过滤（与主 T2V 流程中的模型相同）。

sents.en: For audio, we apply Meta Audiobox Aesthetics [ 43 ] (production quality, complexity, content enjoyment, usefulness) and discard silent or corrupted tracks.
sents.zh: 对于音频，我们应用 Meta Audiobox Aesthetics [43]（制作质量、复杂性、内容趣味性、实用性），并丢弃无声或损坏的音轨。

paragraphs.en: Domain classification: Scenes are classified into 11 domains (people action, animals, cartoons, people speech, music, food, nature, art, architecture, interiors, tech) using combined visual (Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct [ 44 ] ) and audio (Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B) embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: 领域分类：场景通过结合视觉（Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct [ 44 ]）和音频（Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B）嵌入向量，被划分为11个领域（人物动作、动物、卡通、人物语音、音乐、食物、自然、艺术、建筑、室内、科技）。

paragraphs.en: Expert evaluation: Two-stage evaluation is performed by technical screeners and cinematography experts, with emphasis on visual aesthetics, cinematographic quality, audio clarity, semantic audio-visual alignment, and lip-sync accuracy for speech scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 专家评估：由技术筛选员和摄影专家进行两阶段评估，重点关注视觉美学、摄影质量、音频清晰度、语义上的视听一致性以及对话场景的口型同步准确性。

paragraphs.en: Captioning: Audio descriptions are produced with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B, while joint video+audio captions are generated by Qwen3.5-35B-A3B incorporating motion classification labels. All captions are subsequently rewritten into four detail levels: long, medium, short, shortest.
paragraphs.zh: 字幕生成：音频描述由 Gemma-4-E4B-it 和 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 生成，而联合视频+音频字幕则由 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 结合动作分类标签生成。 所有字幕随后被改写为四个详细程度级别：长、中、短、最短。

sents.en: Captioning: Audio descriptions are produced with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B, while joint video+audio captions are generated by Qwen3.5-35B-A3B incorporating motion classification labels.
sents.zh: 字幕生成：音频描述由 Gemma-4-E4B-it 和 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B 生成，而联合视频+音频字幕则由 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 结合动作分类标签生成。

sents.en: All captions are subsequently rewritten into four detail levels: long, medium, short, shortest.
sents.zh: 所有字幕随后被改写为四个详细程度级别：长、中、短、最短。

paragraphs.en: The domain breakdown for the datasets is given in Table 1 . Stage 1 (4,663 scenes) is primarily used for visual enhancement, while Stage 2 (7,686 scenes) expands the data with additional speech and music content to improve synchronization and lip-sync.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集的领域划分如表 1 所示。 第 1 阶段（4,663 个场景）主要用于视觉增强，而第 2 阶段（7,686 个场景）则通过添加语音和音乐内容来扩展数据，以改善同步效果和唇语同步。

sents.en: The domain breakdown for the datasets is given in Table 1 .
sents.zh: 数据集的领域划分如表 1 所示。

sents.en: Stage 1 (4,663 scenes) is primarily used for visual enhancement, while Stage 2 (7,686 scenes) expands the data with additional speech and music content to improve synchronization and lip-sync.
sents.zh: 第 1 阶段（4,663 个场景）主要用于视觉增强，而第 2 阶段（7,686 个场景）则通过添加语音和音乐内容来扩展数据，以改善同步效果和唇语同步。

paragraphs.en: The RL dataset comprises 2,984 curated clips sourced from the SFT collection. Each record contains T2AV-specific captions in English and Russian, with 100% of samples containing an audio caption ( <AUDCAP>...<ENDAUDCAP> ). Precomputed text embeddings are provided for efficient online training. The dataset is used for online RL with per-prompt rollouts and multi-objective rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 该强化学习数据集包含 2,984 个从 SFT 集合中精选的片段。 每条记录都包含针对 T2AV 的英文和俄文描述，且 100% 的样本均包含音频描述（<AUDCAP>...<ENDAUDCAP>）。 数据集提供了预计算的文本嵌入，以实现高效的在线训练。 该数据集用于在线强化学习，支持每个提示的展开过程和多目标奖励机制。

sents.en: The RL dataset comprises 2,984 curated clips sourced from the SFT collection.
sents.zh: 该强化学习数据集包含 2,984 个从 SFT 集合中精选的片段。

sents.en: Each record contains T2AV-specific captions in English and Russian, with 100% of samples containing an audio caption ( <AUDCAP>...<ENDAUDCAP> ).
sents.zh: 每条记录都包含针对 T2AV 的英文和俄文描述，且 100% 的样本均包含音频描述（<AUDCAP>...<ENDAUDCAP>）。

sents.en: Precomputed text embeddings are provided for efficient online training.
sents.zh: 数据集提供了预计算的文本嵌入，以实现高效的在线训练。

sents.en: The dataset is used for online RL with per-prompt rollouts and multi-objective rewards.
sents.zh: 该数据集用于在线强化学习，支持每个提示的展开过程和多目标奖励机制。

paragraphs.en: For super-resolution, we constructed a combined dataset comprising 150,000 unique clips from three sources:
paragraphs.zh: 在超分辨率方面，我们构建了一个组合数据集，其中包含来自三个来源的 150,000 个唯一片段：

paragraphs.en: 4K video collection : 100,000 diverse high-resolution video clips used to construct paired HQ/LQ examples for super-resolution training.
paragraphs.zh: 4K 视频集：包含 100,000 个多样化的高分辨率视频片段，用于构建超分辨率训练所需的成对高清/低清样本。

paragraphs.en: A high-resolution subset of the Kandinsky 5.0 T2V video collection, comprising approximately 35,000 clips, selected through artifact filtering and Q-Align-based quality filtering.
paragraphs.zh: 这是 Kandinsky 5.0 T2V 视频集的一个高分辨率子集，包含约 35,000 个片段，通过人工制品过滤和基于 Q-Align 的质量过滤筛选而出。

paragraphs.en: 15,000 synthetic camera-motion clips constructed from high-resolution images from the Aesthetic-4K dataset [ 45 ] . Each clip is produced by moving a spatial crop along a sampled camera trajectory over a still image, simulating camera motion.
paragraphs.zh: 从 Aesthetic-4K 数据集 [45] 的高分辨率图像中构建的 15,000 个合成相机运动片段。 每个片段都是通过在一幅静态图像上沿采样出的相机轨迹移动空间裁剪区域来生成的，从而模拟相机运动。

sents.en: 15,000 synthetic camera-motion clips constructed from high-resolution images from the Aesthetic-4K dataset [ 45 ] .
sents.zh: 从 Aesthetic-4K 数据集 [45] 的高分辨率图像中构建的 15,000 个合成相机运动片段。

sents.en: Each clip is produced by moving a spatial crop along a sampled camera trajectory over a still image, simulating camera motion.
sents.zh: 每个片段都是通过在一幅静态图像上沿采样出的相机轨迹移动空间裁剪区域来生成的，从而模拟相机运动。

paragraphs.en: We filter the two video datasets using different quality checks. For the Kandinsky 5.0 T2V collection, we check for compression artifacts and visible bands in smooth color gradients, and use Q-Align scores to select high-quality examples. For the 4K video collection, we combine Q-Align scores with a separate ripple detector to remove low-quality examples and those with strong noise-like patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用不同的质量检查方法来筛选这两个视频数据集。 对于 Kandinsky 5.0 T2V 数据集，我们会检查压缩伪影和光滑颜色渐变中可见的色带，并利用 Q-Align 分数来挑选高质量样本。 对于 4K 视频数据集，我们将 Q-Align 分数与独立的波纹检测器结合使用，以去除低质量样本以及具有强噪声样图案的样本。

sents.en: We filter the two video datasets using different quality checks.
sents.zh: 我们使用不同的质量检查方法来筛选这两个视频数据集。

sents.en: For the Kandinsky 5.0 T2V collection, we check for compression artifacts and visible bands in smooth color gradients, and use Q-Align scores to select high-quality examples.
sents.zh: 对于 Kandinsky 5.0 T2V 数据集，我们会检查压缩伪影和光滑颜色渐变中可见的色带，并利用 Q-Align 分数来挑选高质量样本。

sents.en: For the 4K video collection, we combine Q-Align scores with a separate ripple detector to remove low-quality examples and those with strong noise-like patterns.
sents.zh: 对于 4K 视频数据集，我们将 Q-Align 分数与独立的波纹检测器结合使用，以去除低质量样本以及具有强噪声样图案的样本。

paragraphs.en: The preparation of paired HQ/LQ training examples, including crop selection, online filtering, and degradation pipelines, is described in Section 4.6.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 成对的高清/低清训练样本的准备过程，包括裁剪选择、在线过滤和退化处理流程，在第 4.6.1 节中进行了描述。

paragraphs.en: For Kandinsky 6.0 Video, we expanded and updated the Russian Cultural Code (RCC) dataset [ 46 , 47 ] . The dataset comprises 1.2M images and 530K video scenes , specifically curated to represent the Russian cultural code — covering distinctive features related to faith, language, historical memory, nature, architecture, and other culturally significant elements. All samples are annotated with accurate object names and comprehensive scene descriptions, ensuring high-quality data for culturally aware generation. The dataset is used during the T2V pre-training phase and is also injected through images during joint T2AV training, in both cases with English and Russian captions, to support the model’s ability to generate content that aligns with Russian cultural context.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 Kandinsky 6.0 Video，我们扩展并更新了俄罗斯文化代码（RCC）数据集 [46, 47]。 该数据集包含 120 万张图像和 53 万个视频场景，经过专门策划以体现俄罗斯文化代码——涵盖与信仰、语言、历史记忆、自然、建筑及其他具有文化意义的元素相关的独特特征。 所有样本均标注了准确的物体名称和全面的场景描述，从而确保为具备文化感知能力的生成提供高质量数据。 该数据集在 T2V 预训练阶段被使用，并在联合 T2AV 训练期间通过图像注入；两种情况下均包含英语和俄语字幕，以支持模型生成符合俄罗斯文化背景的内容。

sents.en: For Kandinsky 6.0 Video, we expanded and updated the Russian Cultural Code (RCC) dataset [ 46 , 47 ] .
sents.zh: 对于 Kandinsky 6.0 Video，我们扩展并更新了俄罗斯文化代码（RCC）数据集 [46, 47]。

sents.en: The dataset comprises 1.2M images and 530K video scenes , specifically curated to represent the Russian cultural code — covering distinctive features related to faith, language, historical memory, nature, architecture, and other culturally significant elements.
sents.zh: 该数据集包含 120 万张图像和 53 万个视频场景，经过专门策划以体现俄罗斯文化代码——涵盖与信仰、语言、历史记忆、自然、建筑及其他具有文化意义的元素相关的独特特征。

sents.en: All samples are annotated with accurate object names and comprehensive scene descriptions, ensuring high-quality data for culturally aware generation.
sents.zh: 所有样本均标注了准确的物体名称和全面的场景描述，从而确保为具备文化感知能力的生成提供高质量数据。

sents.en: The dataset is used during the T2V pre-training phase and is also injected through images during joint T2AV training, in both cases with English and Russian captions, to support the model’s ability to generate content that aligns with Russian cultural context.
sents.zh: 该数据集在 T2V 预训练阶段被使用，并在联合 T2AV 训练期间通过图像注入；两种情况下均包含英语和俄语字幕，以支持模型生成符合俄罗斯文化背景的内容。

paragraphs.en: Kandinsky 6.0 Video is released in two versions: Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both versions share the same architecture and are trained with flow matching [ 3 ] , so we describe it in general terms below and point out version-specific differences where they apply.
paragraphs.zh: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 推出了两个版本：Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite（3B 参数）和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro（29B 参数）。 两个版本采用相同的架构，并通过流匹配 [ 3 ] 进行训练，因此我们在下文中将作一般性描述，并在适用之处指出各版本之间的具体差异。

sents.en: Kandinsky 6.0 Video is released in two versions: Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters).
sents.zh: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 推出了两个版本：Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite（3B 参数）和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro（29B 参数）。

sents.en: Both versions share the same architecture and are trained with flow matching [ 3 ] , so we describe it in general terms below and point out version-specific differences where they apply.
sents.zh: 两个版本采用相同的架构，并通过流匹配 [ 3 ] 进行训练，因此我们在下文中将作一般性描述，并在适用之处指出各版本之间的具体差异。

paragraphs.en: The core of the model is a CrossDiT network that inherits the architecture of Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ] and extends it to two modalities, video and audio. This core component is described in detail in Section 3.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 该模型的核心是一个 CrossDiT 网络，它继承了 Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ] 的架构，并将其扩展至视频和音频两种模态。 这一核心组件在第 3.2 节中有详细描述。

sents.en: The core of the model is a CrossDiT network that inherits the architecture of Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ] and extends it to two modalities, video and audio.
sents.zh: 该模型的核心是一个 CrossDiT 网络，它继承了 Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ] 的架构，并将其扩展至视频和音频两种模态。

sents.en: This core component is described in detail in Section 3.2 .
sents.zh: 这一核心组件在第 3.2 节中有详细描述。

paragraphs.en: Both versions use the Hunyuan VAE [ 9 ] for video encoding and decoding and the MMAudio autoencoder [ 48 ] , which supports a sampling rate of 44 kHz, for audio. Text is encoded with Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 44 ] and CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 27 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 两个版本都使用 Hunyuan VAE [ 9 ] 进行视频编码和解码，并使用支持 44 kHz 采样率的 MMAudio 自动编码器 [ 48 ] 处理音频。 文本使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 44 ] 和 CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 27 ] 进行编码。

sents.en: Both versions use the Hunyuan VAE [ 9 ] for video encoding and decoding and the MMAudio autoencoder [ 48 ] , which supports a sampling rate of 44 kHz, for audio.
sents.zh: 两个版本都使用 Hunyuan VAE [ 9 ] 进行视频编码和解码，并使用支持 44 kHz 采样率的 MMAudio 自动编码器 [ 48 ] 处理音频。

sents.en: Text is encoded with Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 44 ] and CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 27 ] .
sents.zh: 文本使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct [ 44 ] 和 CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 27 ] 进行编码。

paragraphs.en: The super-resolution model, which is applied to the output of the trained model to obtain Full-HD resolution, is described in Section 3.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 超分辨率模型用于对训练好的模型输出进行处理，以获得全高清分辨率，相关内容在第 3.3 节中进行了描述。

paragraphs.en: The core of Kandinsky 6.0 Video is a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that processes the video and audio modalities, similar to Ovi [ 49 ] and LTX-2 [ 18 ] . It comprises asymmetric DiT backbones for video and audio, connected by blockwise bidirectional cross-attention.
paragraphs.zh: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 的核心是一种双流 CrossDiT 架构，该架构能够处理视频和音频模态，与 Ovi [ 49 ] 和 LTX-2 [ 18 ] 类似。 它由用于视频和音频的非对称 DiT 主干网络组成，并通过分块双向交叉注意力相互连接。

sents.en: The core of Kandinsky 6.0 Video is a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that processes the video and audio modalities, similar to Ovi [ 49 ] and LTX-2 [ 18 ] .
sents.zh: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 的核心是一种双流 CrossDiT 架构，该架构能够处理视频和音频模态，与 Ovi [ 49 ] 和 LTX-2 [ 18 ] 类似。

sents.en: It comprises asymmetric DiT backbones for video and audio, connected by blockwise bidirectional cross-attention.
sents.zh: 它由用于视频和音频的非对称 DiT 主干网络组成，并通过分块双向交叉注意力相互连接。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows a simplified scheme of a single block with both streams and the cross-attention that connects them; a detailed diagram is given in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 图1展示了一个单块结构的简化方案，其中包含了两个流以及连接它们的交叉注意力机制；详细的示意图见图2。

paragraphs.en: Each stream inherits its architecture from Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ] . The two streams have the same number of transformer blocks but differ in hidden and feed-forward (FFN) dimensions and, consequently, in parameter count.
paragraphs.zh: 每个流都继承自 Kandinsky 5.0 的架构 [ 11 ]。 这两个流的变压器模块数量相同，但隐藏层和前馈网络（FFN）的维度不同，因此参数数量也存在差异。

sents.en: Each stream inherits its architecture from Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: 每个流都继承自 Kandinsky 5.0 的架构 [ 11 ]。

sents.en: The two streams have the same number of transformer blocks but differ in hidden and feed-forward (FFN) dimensions and, consequently, in parameter count.
sents.zh: 这两个流的变压器模块数量相同，但隐藏层和前馈网络（FFN）的维度不同，因此参数数量也存在差异。

paragraphs.en: In Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters in total), the video stream has 2B parameters, the audio stream 0.6B, and the cross-attention layers between the streams 0.4B. In Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B in total), the video stream has 19B parameters, the audio stream 5B, and the cross-attention layers 5B.

paragraphs.en: To obtain Full-HD output, videos generated by Kandinsky 6.0 Video are upscaled by a separate video super-resolution (SR) model. Unlike the base generator, which uses the Hunyuan VAE, the SR model operates in the latent space of K-VAE [ 51 ] , a video autoencoder with 64 latent channels and 16 × 16\times spatial and 4 × 4\times temporal compression. For spatially aligned inputs with T = 4 ​ n + 1 T=4n+1 frames, a clip of T × H × W T\times H\times W pixels is encoded into a latent of size T ′ × H 16 × W 16 × 64 T^{\prime}\times\frac{H}{16}\times\frac{W}{16}\times 64 , where T ′ = ( T − 1 ) / 4 + 1 T^{\prime}=(T-1)/4+1 . Thus, a 121-frame clip corresponds to 31 latent frames.
paragraphs.zh: 为了获得全高清输出，Kandinsky 6.0 Video 生成的视频会通过一个独立的视频超分辨率（SR）模型进行升频。 与使用 Hunyuan VAE 的基础生成器不同，该 SR 模型在 K-VAE [51] 的潜在空间中运行，K-VAE 是一种具有 64 个潜在通道、16×16 空间压缩和 4×4 时间压缩的视频自编码器。 对于空间对齐且帧数满足 T = 4n + 1 的输入，一个尺寸为 T × H × W 像素的视频片段会被编码为尺寸 T′ × H/16 × W/16 × 64 的潜在表示，其中 T′ = (T − 1)/4 + 1。 因此，一个包含 121 帧的视频片段对应于 31 个潜在帧。

sents.zh: 对于空间对齐且帧数满足 T = 4n + 1 的输入，一个尺寸为 T × H × W 像素的视频片段会被编码为尺寸 T′ × H/16 × W/16 × 64 的潜在表示，其中 T′ = (T − 1)/4 + 1。

paragraphs.en: The SR model consists of two components trained separately:
paragraphs.zh: SR 模型由两个分别训练的成分组成：

paragraphs.en: the Latent Upscaler (LU), a convolutional network that deterministically upsamples a low-quality (LQ) latent by a factor of 2 2 or 4 4 to the working resolution of the SR-DiT (Section 3.3.2 );
paragraphs.zh: 潜在上采样器（Latent Upscaler，LU）是一种卷积网络，能够以确定性方式将低质量（LQ）的潜在表示按 2 倍或 4 倍的比例上采样至 SR-DiT 的工作分辨率（第 3.3.2 节）；

paragraphs.en: the SR-DiT , a flow-matching diffusion transformer that removes degradations and restores detail in the upsampled latent (Section 3.3.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: SR-DiT 是一种流匹配扩散变换器，能够去除上采样潜在空间中的退化并恢复细节（第 3.3.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: A single SR-DiT is trained jointly for the × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 routes, while the LU uses scale-specific branches.
paragraphs.zh: 单个 SR-DiT 被联合训练用于 × 2 \times 2 和 × 4 \times 4 路线，而 LU 则使用针对特定比例的分支。

paragraphs.en: In our inference pipeline, the SR-DiT processes spatial tiles (height × \times width) corresponding to 512 × 768 512\times 768 px for landscape content, 768 × 512 768\times 512 px for portrait content, and 512 × 512 512\times 512 px for square content. These correspond to latent grids of 32 × 48 32\times 48 , 48 × 32 48\times 32 , and 32 × 32 32\times 32 cells, respectively, with 64 channels. For a fixed scale and working tile size, larger input videos require more tiles (Section 5 ). The SR model supports scale factors of × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 ; the × 2.25 \times 2.25 route used for Full-HD output combines bilinear × 1.125 \times 1.125 pre-upscaling in pixel space with the × 2 \times 2 route.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的推理流程中，SR-DiT 处理空间分块（高度 × 宽度），分别对应横版内容的 512 × 768 px、竖版内容的 768 × 512 px 以及方形内容的 512 × 512 px。 这些分别对应于 32 × 48、48 × 32 和 32 × 32 个单元组成的潜在网格，且均包含 64 个通道。 在固定比例和工作分块尺寸的情况下，输入视频越大，所需的分块数量也越多（第 5 节）。 SR 模型支持 × 2 和 × 4 的比例因子；用于全高清输出的 × 2.25 方案，则将像素空间中的双线性 × 1.125 预上采样与 × 2 方案相结合。

paragraphs.en: The SR-DiT (Figure 3 ) is based on Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite [ 11 ] . It is initialized from a text-free Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite (SFT) checkpoint operating in the K-VAE latent space. The model has 32 transformer blocks with a hidden dimension of 1792, 28 attention heads of dimension 64, an FFN dimension of 7168, and a timestep embedding dimension of 512. The backbone with the standard velocity head contains approximately 1.41B parameters.
paragraphs.zh: SR-DiT（图3）基于 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite [11]。 它从一个无需文本的 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite（SFT）检查点初始化，该检查点在 K-VAE 潜在空间中运行。 该模型包含 32 个变换器块，隐藏维度为 1792，注意力头有 28 个，每个维度为 64，FFN 维度为 7168，时间步嵌入维度为 512。 带有标准速度头的骨干网络大约包含 14.1 亿个参数。

sents.en: The SR-DiT (Figure 3 ) is based on Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite [ 11 ] .
sents.zh: SR-DiT（图3）基于 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite [11]。

sents.en: It is initialized from a text-free Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite (SFT) checkpoint operating in the K-VAE latent space.
sents.zh: 它从一个无需文本的 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite（SFT）检查点初始化，该检查点在 K-VAE 潜在空间中运行。

sents.en: The model has 32 transformer blocks with a hidden dimension of 1792, 28 attention heads of dimension 64, an FFN dimension of 7168, and a timestep embedding dimension of 512.
sents.zh: 该模型包含 32 个变换器块，隐藏维度为 1792，注意力头有 28 个，每个维度为 64，FFN 维度为 7168，时间步嵌入维度为 512。

sents.en: The backbone with the standard velocity head contains approximately 1.41B parameters.
sents.zh: 带有标准速度头的骨干网络大约包含 14.1 亿个参数。

paragraphs.en: The SR-DiT does not use text encoders or text cross-attention and requires no prompt. The pooled text contribution to the timestep conditioning is replaced with a learnable constant ( pooled bias ). Each block uses six modulation vectors: scale, shift, and gate for self-attention and for the FFN, instead of the nine vectors used by the text-conditioned architecture. A SiLU activation followed by a linear projection 512 → 6 × 1792 512\to 6\times 1792 produces these vectors. The pretrained modulation weights are inherited from the initialization checkpoint.
paragraphs.zh: SR-DiT 不使用文本编码器或文本交叉注意力，且不需要提示。 时间步条件中来自池化文本的贡献被一个可学习的常数（池化偏置）所替代。 每个模块使用六个调制向量：用于自注意力和前馈网络的缩放、偏移和门控向量，而不是文本条件架构所使用的九个向量。 一个 SiLU 激活函数，随后是一个线性投影 512 → 6 × 1792，可生成这些向量。 预训练的调制权重从初始化检查点中继承而来。

sents.zh: 时间步条件中来自池化文本的贡献被一个可学习的常数（池化偏置）所替代。

sents.en: Each block uses six modulation vectors: scale, shift, and gate for self-attention and for the FFN, instead of the nine vectors used by the text-conditioned architecture.

sents.en: A SiLU activation followed by a linear projection 512 → 6 × 1792 512\to 6\times 1792 produces these vectors.
sents.zh: 一个 SiLU 激活函数，随后是一个线性投影 512 → 6 × 1792，可生成这些向量。

sents.en: The pretrained modulation weights are inherited from the initialization checkpoint.
sents.zh: 预训练的调制权重从初始化检查点中继承而来。

paragraphs.en: The model receives a 64-channel noisy latent x t x_{t} together with a 64-channel anchor tensor and a binary anchor mask. When an HQ anchor is provided, its latent occupies the first temporal position of the anchor tensor, and the mask is one at that position; the remaining positions are zero. When the anchor is absent, both the anchor tensor and its mask are zero. The concatenated input [ x t ​ | anchor | ​ mask ] [x_{t}\,|\,\text{anchor}\,|\,\text{mask}] therefore always has 64 + 64 + 1 = 129 64+64+1=129 channels.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型接收一个 64 通道的含噪潜在表示 x t x_{t}，以及一个 64 通道的锚张量和一个二进制锚掩码。 当提供高清晰度锚时，其潜在表示占据锚张量的第一个时间位置，且该位置的掩码值为 1；其余位置均为 0。 当没有锚时，锚张量及其掩码均设为 0。 因此，拼接后的输入 [ x t ​ | anchor | ​ mask ] [x_{t}\,|\,\text{anchor}\,|\,\text{mask}] 始终具有 64 + 64 + 1 = 129 个通道。

sents.zh: 该模型接收一个 64 通道的含噪潜在表示 x t x_{t}，以及一个 64 通道的锚张量和一个二进制锚掩码。

paragraphs.en: The patch size is ( 1 , 1 , 1 ) (1,1,1) , so each token corresponds to one latent cell, at a spatial stride of 16 px. A 512 × 768 512\times 768 tile yields 1536 tokens per latent frame, while a 512 × 512 512\times 512 tile yields 1024. A linear projection 129 → 1792 129\to 1792 maps the input tokens to the model width. The × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 routes use the same SR-DiT weights and input dimensions, with their inputs prepared by the corresponding LU branches.
paragraphs.zh: 补丁大小为 (1, 1, 1)，因此每个词元对应一个潜在单元，空间步长为 16 像素。 一个 512 × 768 的图像块可生成每帧潜在图像 1536 个词元，而一个 512 × 512 的图像块则可生成 1024 个。 一个线性投影 129 → 1792 将输入词元映射到模型宽度。 ×2 和 ×4 路径使用相同的 SR-DiT 权重和输入维度，其输入由相应的 LU 分支准备。

sents.en: The patch size is ( 1 , 1 , 1 ) (1,1,1) , so each token corresponds to one latent cell, at a spatial stride of 16 px.
sents.zh: 补丁大小为 (1, 1, 1)，因此每个词元对应一个潜在单元，空间步长为 16 像素。

sents.en: A 512 × 768 512\times 768 tile yields 1536 tokens per latent frame, while a 512 × 512 512\times 512 tile yields 1024.
sents.zh: 一个 512 × 768 的图像块可生成每帧潜在图像 1536 个词元，而一个 512 × 512 的图像块则可生成 1024 个。

sents.en: A linear projection 129 → 1792 129\to 1792 maps the input tokens to the model width.
sents.zh: 一个线性投影 129 → 1792 将输入词元映射到模型宽度。

sents.en: The × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 routes use the same SR-DiT weights and input dimensions, with their inputs prepared by the corresponding LU branches.
sents.zh: ×2 和 ×4 路径使用相同的 SR-DiT 权重和输入维度，其输入由相应的 LU 分支准备。

paragraphs.en: Each block contains self-attention and an FFN with residual connections, LayerNorm without learnable affine parameters, and adaLN-Zero modulation. Queries and keys are normalized with RMSNorm within each head. The model uses 3D RoPE, with the head dimension split into ( 16 , 24 , 24 ) (16,24,24) channels for the temporal, height, and width axes, corresponding to 8, 12, and 12 rotary frequency pairs. The positional rotations are shared across all 32 blocks.
paragraphs.zh: 每个块都包含自注意力和带有残差连接的 FFN、不含可学习仿射参数的 LayerNorm，以及 adaLN-Zero 调制。 在每个头内部，查询和键通过 RMSNorm 进行归一化。 该模型使用 3D RoPE，其中头的维度被拆分为 (16, 24, 24) 个通道，分别对应时间、高度和宽度轴，分别对应 8、12 和 12 对旋转频率。 位置旋转在所有 32 个块中共享。

sents.en: Each block contains self-attention and an FFN with residual connections, LayerNorm without learnable affine parameters, and adaLN-Zero modulation.
sents.zh: 每个块都包含自注意力和带有残差连接的 FFN、不含可学习仿射参数的 LayerNorm，以及 adaLN-Zero 调制。

sents.en: Queries and keys are normalized with RMSNorm within each head.
sents.zh: 在每个头内部，查询和键通过 RMSNorm 进行归一化。

sents.en: The model uses 3D RoPE, with the head dimension split into ( 16 , 24 , 24 ) (16,24,24) channels for the temporal, height, and width axes, corresponding to 8, 12, and 12 rotary frequency pairs.
sents.zh: 该模型使用 3D RoPE，其中头的维度被拆分为 (16, 24, 24) 个通道，分别对应时间、高度和宽度轴，分别对应 8、12 和 12 对旋转频率。

sents.en: The positional rotations are shared across all 32 blocks.
sents.zh: 位置旋转在所有 32 个块中共享。

paragraphs.en: Attention is dense (FlashAttention) in the first training stage and is replaced with sparse NABLA attention [ 12 ] during the second stage (Section 4.6 ). The FFN consists of two bias-free linear layers, 1792 → 7168 → 1792 1792\to 7168\to 1792 , with a GELU activation between them. It accounts for approximately 58% of each block’s parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一个训练阶段，注意力是稠密的（FlashAttention），而在第二个阶段（第 4.6 节）则被稀疏的 NABLA 注意力 [ 12 ] 所取代。 FFN 由两个无偏置的线性层组成：1792 → 7168 → 1792，中间使用 GELU 激活函数。 它占每个块参数的约 58%。

sents.en: Attention is dense (FlashAttention) in the first training stage and is replaced with sparse NABLA attention [ 12 ] during the second stage (Section 4.6 ).
sents.zh: 在第一个训练阶段，注意力是稠密的（FlashAttention），而在第二个阶段（第 4.6 节）则被稀疏的 NABLA 注意力 [ 12 ] 所取代。

sents.en: The FFN consists of two bias-free linear layers, 1792 → 7168 → 1792 1792\to 7168\to 1792 , with a GELU activation between them.
sents.zh: FFN 由两个无偏置的线性层组成：1792 → 7168 → 1792，中间使用 GELU 激活函数。

sents.en: It accounts for approximately 58% of each block’s parameters.
sents.zh: 它占每个块参数的约 58%。

paragraphs.en: Before distillation, the output head consists of a LayerNorm modulated by the timestep conditioning through scale and shift, followed by a linear projection 1792 → 64 1792\to 64 that predicts the velocity. Each transformer block contains approximately 44.06M parameters: 5.52M in modulation, 12.85M in attention, and 25.69M in the FFN. Including the input projection, timestep embedding, pooled bias, and output head, the model contains approximately 1.413B parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 在蒸馏之前，输出头由一个通过缩放和偏移受时间步条件调节的 LayerNorm 组成，随后是一个线性投影 1792 → 64 1792\to 64，用于预测速度。 每个 Transformer 块包含约 44.06M 个参数：其中调制部分为 5.52M，注意力部分为 12.85M，FFN 部分为 25.69M。 包括输入投影、时间步嵌入、池化偏置和输出头，该模型总共包含约 1.413B 个参数。

sents.en: Before distillation, the output head consists of a LayerNorm modulated by the timestep conditioning through scale and shift, followed by a linear projection 1792 → 64 1792\to 64 that predicts the velocity.
sents.zh: 在蒸馏之前，输出头由一个通过缩放和偏移受时间步条件调节的 LayerNorm 组成，随后是一个线性投影 1792 → 64 1792\to 64，用于预测速度。

sents.en: Each transformer block contains approximately 44.06M parameters: 5.52M in modulation, 12.85M in attention, and 25.69M in the FFN.
sents.zh: 每个 Transformer 块包含约 44.06M 个参数：其中调制部分为 5.52M，注意力部分为 12.85M，FFN 部分为 25.69M。

sents.en: Including the input projection, timestep embedding, pooled bias, and output head, the model contains approximately 1.413B parameters.
sents.zh: 包括输入投影、时间步嵌入、池化偏置和输出头，该模型总共包含约 1.413B 个参数。

paragraphs.en: For π \pi -Flow DX distillation, the final projection is expanded to 1792 → 640 1792\to 640 , producing ten 64-channel outputs per token for constructing the DX policy (Section 4.6 ). The transformer backbone is unchanged, and the expanded head adds approximately 1.03M parameters. Figure 3 shows the architecture with the standard velocity head.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 π -Flow DX 蒸馏，最终投影被扩展为 1792 → 640，从而为每个标记生成十个 64 通道的输出，用于构建 DX 策略（第 4.6 节）。 Transformer 主干保持不变，而扩展后的头部分增加了约 103 万个参数。 图 3 展示了包含标准速度头的架构。

sents.en: For π \pi -Flow DX distillation, the final projection is expanded to 1792 → 640 1792\to 640 , producing ten 64-channel outputs per token for constructing the DX policy (Section 4.6 ).
sents.zh: 对于 π -Flow DX 蒸馏，最终投影被扩展为 1792 → 640，从而为每个标记生成十个 64 通道的输出，用于构建 DX 策略（第 4.6 节）。

sents.en: The transformer backbone is unchanged, and the expanded head adds approximately 1.03M parameters.
sents.zh: Transformer 主干保持不变，而扩展后的头部分增加了约 103 万个参数。

sents.en: Figure 3 shows the architecture with the standard velocity head.
sents.zh: 图 3 展示了包含标准速度头的架构。

paragraphs.en: The Latent Upscaler (LU; Figure 4 ) brings the LQ latent to the working resolution of the SR-DiT directly in latent space, without decoding to pixels. Its architecture is derived from the K-VAE decoder: the × 4 \times 4 model follows the decoder’s channel widths, residual blocks, modulated normalization, and spatial upsampling modules over two upsampling stages. Unlike the decoder, it outputs 64-channel latents instead of pixels and preserves the temporal resolution. The × 2 \times 2 branch is constructed from the trained × 4 \times 4 model with a shorter front section and one spatial upsampling stage.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在上采样器（LU；图 4）直接在潜在空间中，将低质量（LQ）潜在表示提升至 SR-DiT 的工作分辨率，而无需解码为像素。 其架构源自 K-VAE 解码器：×4 模型沿用了该解码器的通道宽度、残差块、调制归一化以及两个上采样阶段中的空间上采样模块。 与解码器不同，它输出的是 64 通道的潜在表示而非像素，并保留了时间分辨率。 ×2 分支由训练好的 ×4 模型构建而成，其前端部分较短，且仅包含一个空间上采样阶段。

sents.en: The Latent Upscaler (LU; Figure 4 ) brings the LQ latent to the working resolution of the SR-DiT directly in latent space, without decoding to pixels.
sents.zh: 潜在上采样器（LU；图 4）直接在潜在空间中，将低质量（LQ）潜在表示提升至 SR-DiT 的工作分辨率，而无需解码为像素。

sents.en: Its architecture is derived from the K-VAE decoder: the × 4 \times 4 model follows the decoder’s channel widths, residual blocks, modulated normalization, and spatial upsampling modules over two upsampling stages.
sents.zh: 其架构源自 K-VAE 解码器：×4 模型沿用了该解码器的通道宽度、残差块、调制归一化以及两个上采样阶段中的空间上采样模块。

sents.en: Unlike the decoder, it outputs 64-channel latents instead of pixels and preserves the temporal resolution.
sents.zh: 与解码器不同，它输出的是 64 通道的潜在表示而非像素，并保留了时间分辨率。

sents.en: The × 2 \times 2 branch is constructed from the trained × 4 \times 4 model with a shorter front section and one spatial upsampling stage.
sents.zh: ×2 分支由训练好的 ×4 模型构建而成，其前端部分较短，且仅包含一个空间上采样阶段。

paragraphs.en: The LU replaces pixel-space bilinear resizing followed by K-VAE encoding of each upscaled tile. Instead, the source video is encoded once, and spatial tiles are extracted and upscaled directly in latent space. This avoids separately encoding each upscaled pixel tile and reduces inference time (Section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: LU 取代了像素空间中的双线性重采样，以及随后对每个上采样图块进行 K-VAE 编码的步骤。 相反，源视频只需编码一次，然后直接在潜在空间中提取并上采样空间图块。 这避免了单独对每个上采样的像素图块进行编码，并减少了推理时间（第 5 节）。

sents.en: The LU replaces pixel-space bilinear resizing followed by K-VAE encoding of each upscaled tile.
sents.zh: LU 取代了像素空间中的双线性重采样，以及随后对每个上采样图块进行 K-VAE 编码的步骤。

sents.en: Instead, the source video is encoded once, and spatial tiles are extracted and upscaled directly in latent space.
sents.zh: 相反，源视频只需编码一次，然后直接在潜在空间中提取并上采样空间图块。

sents.en: This avoids separately encoding each upscaled pixel tile and reduces inference time (Section 5 ).
sents.zh: 这避免了单独对每个上采样的像素图块进行编码，并减少了推理时间（第 5 节）。

paragraphs.en: For a landscape tile, the LU maps an 8 × 12 8\times 12 latent grid ( 128 × 192 128\times 192 px of the source video) to 32 × 48 32\times 48 for the × 4 \times 4 route, and a 16 × 24 16\times 24 grid ( 256 × 384 256\times 384 px) to 32 × 48 32\times 48 for the × 2 \times 2 route.
paragraphs.zh: 对于景观瓦片，LU 将 8×12 的 8\times 12 潜在网格（源视频的 128×192 128\times 192 像素）映射到 32×48 的 32\times 48 网格，用于 ×4 \times 4 路线；并将 16×24 的 16\times 24 网格（256×384 256\times 384 像素）映射到 32×48 的 32\times 48 网格，用于 ×2 \times 2 路线。

paragraphs.en: The architecture follows the widths and block counts of the K-VAE decoder over the part spanning two spatial upsampling stages. The input stem, residual blocks, and upsampling modules are initialized from the decoder; the output heads are initialized randomly. The × 4 \times 4 inference path consists of:
paragraphs.zh: 该架构在跨越两个空间上采样阶段的区域中，遵循 K-VAE 解码器的宽度和块数。 输入茎、残差块和上采样模块从解码器初始化；输出头则随机初始化。 × 4 \times 4 推理路径包括：

sents.en: The architecture follows the widths and block counts of the K-VAE decoder over the part spanning two spatial upsampling stages.
sents.zh: 该架构在跨越两个空间上采样阶段的区域中，遵循 K-VAE 解码器的宽度和块数。

sents.en: The input stem, residual blocks, and upsampling modules are initialized from the decoder; the output heads are initialized randomly.
sents.zh: 输入茎、残差块和上采样模块从解码器初始化；输出头则随机初始化。

sents.en: The × 4 \times 4 inference path consists of:
sents.zh: × 4 \times 4 推理路径包括：

paragraphs.en: an input stem: a 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 convolution 64 → 2048 64\to 2048 without normalization or activation (3.5M parameters);
paragraphs.zh: 输入茎：一个 3 × 3 × 3 的 3\times 3\times 3 卷积，64 → 2048，64\to 2048，无归一化或激活（350 万个参数）；

paragraphs.en: five ResBlocks at width 2048, operating at the input resolution (1135.2M parameters);
paragraphs.zh: 五个宽度为 2048 的 ResBlock，以输入分辨率运行（1135.2M 个参数）；

paragraphs.en: the first × 2 \times 2 spatial upsampling module (41.9M);
paragraphs.zh: 第一个 × 2 \times 2 空间上采样模块（41.9M）；

paragraphs.en: three ResBlocks, with the first reducing the width from 2048 to 1024 (201.2M);
paragraphs.zh: 三个 ResBlock，其中第一个将宽度从 2048 减少到 1024（201.2M）；

paragraphs.en: the second × 2 \times 2 spatial upsampling module (10.5M);
paragraphs.zh: 第二个 × 2 \times 2 空间上采样模块（10.5M）；

paragraphs.en: three ResBlocks, with the first reducing the width from 1024 to 512 (50.5M);
paragraphs.zh: 三个 ResBlock，其中第一个将宽度从 1024 减少到 512（50.5M）；

paragraphs.en: an output head consisting of ModRMSNorm, SiLU, and a 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 convolution 512 → 64 512\to 64 (1.0M).
paragraphs.zh: 一个输出头，由 ModRMSNorm、SiLU 和一个 3 × 3 × 3 的卷积层组成，实现 512 → 64 的变换（1.0M）。

paragraphs.en: These modules contain approximately 1.44B parameters, of which about 79% belong to the five input-resolution ResBlocks.
paragraphs.zh: 这些模块包含约 14.4 亿个参数，其中大约 79% 属于五个输入分辨率的 ResBlock。

paragraphs.en: Each ResBlock consists of two ModRMSNorm–SiLU–Conv3d units with a residual connection and no bottleneck. Blocks that reduce the channel width use a 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 projection in the residual connection. All normalization layers, including the one in the output head, are modulated by the input LQ latent z q z_{q} . The conditioning latent is resized with nearest-neighbor interpolation to match the current feature grid, and 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolutions produce the modulation scale and shift.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 ResBlock 由两个 ModRMSNorm–SiLU–Conv3d 单元组成，带有残差连接且没有瓶颈。 用于减少通道宽度的模块在残差连接中使用一个 1 × 1 × 1 的投影层。 所有归一化层（包括输出头中的归一化层）都由输入 LQ 潜在变量 z q z_{q} 进行调制。 条件潜在变量通过最近邻插值调整大小，以匹配当前的特征网格，并通过 1 × 1 × 1 的卷积生成调制缩放因子和偏移量。

sents.en: Each ResBlock consists of two ModRMSNorm–SiLU–Conv3d units with a residual connection and no bottleneck.
sents.zh: 每个 ResBlock 由两个 ModRMSNorm–SiLU–Conv3d 单元组成，带有残差连接且没有瓶颈。

sents.en: Blocks that reduce the channel width use a 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 projection in the residual connection.
sents.zh: 用于减少通道宽度的模块在残差连接中使用一个 1 × 1 × 1 的投影层。

sents.en: All normalization layers, including the one in the output head, are modulated by the input LQ latent z q z_{q} .
sents.zh: 所有归一化层（包括输出头中的归一化层）都由输入 LQ 潜在变量 z q z_{q} 进行调制。

sents.en: The conditioning latent is resized with nearest-neighbor interpolation to match the current feature grid, and 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolutions produce the modulation scale and shift.
sents.zh: 条件潜在变量通过最近邻插值调整大小，以匹配当前的特征网格，并通过 1 × 1 × 1 的卷积生成调制缩放因子和偏移量。

paragraphs.en: Each spatial upsampling module doubles the height and width using nearest-neighbor resizing, followed by a residual ( 1 , 3 , 3 ) (1,3,3) convolution and a 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolution. The 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 convolutions use symmetric temporal padding with replicated edge frames. When transferring weights from the causal K-VAE decoder, the temporal kernels are shifted to align them with this symmetric window.
paragraphs.zh: 每个空间上采样模块都通过最近邻重采样将高和宽加倍，随后进行残差 (1,3,3) 卷积和 1×1×1 卷积。 3×3×3 卷积使用对称时间填充，并复制边缘帧。 在从因果 K-VAE 解码器转移权重时，时间核会被偏移以与这个对称窗口对齐。

sents.en: Each spatial upsampling module doubles the height and width using nearest-neighbor resizing, followed by a residual ( 1 , 3 , 3 ) (1,3,3) convolution and a 1 × 1 × 1 1\times 1\times 1 convolution.
sents.zh: 每个空间上采样模块都通过最近邻重采样将高和宽加倍，随后进行残差 (1,3,3) 卷积和 1×1×1 卷积。

sents.en: The 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 convolutions use symmetric temporal padding with replicated edge frames.
sents.zh: 3×3×3 卷积使用对称时间填充，并复制边缘帧。

sents.en: When transferring weights from the causal K-VAE decoder, the temporal kernels are shifted to align them with this symmetric window.
sents.zh: 在从因果 K-VAE 解码器转移权重时，时间核会被偏移以与这个对称窗口对齐。

paragraphs.en: For the same output tile, the × 2 \times 2 input contains four times as many spatial latent cells as the × 4 \times 4 input. Applying all five 2048-wide ResBlocks on this larger grid would substantially increase computation. The × 2 \times 2 branch therefore uses a shorter front section and only one spatial upsampling stage.
paragraphs.zh: 对于相同的输出图块，×2 \times 2 输入包含的时空潜在单元数量是 ×4 \times 4 输入的四倍。 如果在这个更大的网格上应用全部五个宽度为 2048 的 ResBlock，计算量将会大幅增加。 因此，×2 \times 2 分支使用较短的前端部分，并且仅包含一个时空上采样阶段。

sents.en: For the same output tile, the × 2 \times 2 input contains four times as many spatial latent cells as the × 4 \times 4 input.
sents.zh: 对于相同的输出图块，×2 \times 2 输入包含的时空潜在单元数量是 ×4 \times 4 输入的四倍。

sents.en: Applying all five 2048-wide ResBlocks on this larger grid would substantially increase computation.
sents.zh: 如果在这个更大的网格上应用全部五个宽度为 2048 的 ResBlock，计算量将会大幅增加。

sents.en: The × 2 \times 2 branch therefore uses a shorter front section and only one spatial upsampling stage.
sents.zh: 因此，×2 \times 2 分支使用较短的前端部分，并且仅包含一个时空上采样阶段。

paragraphs.en: The × 2 \times 2 branch is trained after the × 4 \times 4 model and initialized from its trained checkpoint. All branch modules are copied from the × 4 \times 4 model, with no randomly initialized parameters:
paragraphs.zh: × 2 \times 2 分支在 × 4 \times 4 模型训练完成后进行训练，并从其训练好的检查点初始化。 所有分支模块均从 × 4 \times 4 模型中复制而来，没有任何随机初始化的参数：

sents.en: The × 2 \times 2 branch is trained after the × 4 \times 4 model and initialized from its trained checkpoint.
sents.zh: × 2 \times 2 分支在 × 4 \times 4 模型训练完成后进行训练，并从其训练好的检查点初始化。

sents.en: All branch modules are copied from the × 4 \times 4 model, with no randomly initialized parameters:
sents.zh: 所有分支模块均从 × 4 \times 4 模型中复制而来，没有任何随机初始化的参数：

paragraphs.en: the input stem is copied from the × 4 \times 4 stem;
paragraphs.zh: 输入词干是从 × 4 \times 4 词干中复制的；

paragraphs.en: two 2048-wide adapter ResBlocks are copied from the first and fifth ResBlocks of the × 4 \times 4 model;
paragraphs.zh: 从 × 4 \times 4 模型的第一和第五个 ResBlock 中复制了两个宽度为 2048 的适配器 ResBlock；

paragraphs.en: the convolutions of the first upsampling module are copied and applied without nearest-neighbor resizing;
paragraphs.zh: 第一个上采样模块的卷积被复制并应用，且未进行最近邻重采样；

paragraphs.en: the remaining modules are separate copies of the three 2048 → 1024 2048\to 1024 ResBlocks, the second upsampling module, the three 1024 → 512 1024\to 512 ResBlocks, and the output head.
paragraphs.zh: 其余模块分别是三个 2048 → 1024 的 2048\to 1024 ResBlock 的独立副本、第二个上采样模块、三个 1024 → 512 的 1024\to 512 ResBlock，以及输出头。

paragraphs.en: All modulated normalization layers in this branch are conditioned on the × 2 \times 2 input latent. The original × 4 \times 4 path remains frozen throughout × 2 \times 2 training, while all copied × 2 \times 2 modules are optimized from the first training step. The × 2 \times 2 inference path contains approximately 0.763B parameters and does not execute the original × 4 \times 4 path.
paragraphs.zh: 该分支中所有经过调节的归一化层都以 × 2 \times 2 输入潜在变量为条件。 原始的 × 4 \times 4 路径在整个 × 2 \times 2 训练过程中保持冻结，而所有复制的 × 2 \times 2 模块则从第一步训练开始进行优化。 × 2 \times 2 推理路径包含约 0.763B 个参数，并且不会执行原始的 × 4 \times 4 路径。

sents.en: All modulated normalization layers in this branch are conditioned on the × 2 \times 2 input latent.
sents.zh: 该分支中所有经过调节的归一化层都以 × 2 \times 2 输入潜在变量为条件。

sents.en: The original × 4 \times 4 path remains frozen throughout × 2 \times 2 training, while all copied × 2 \times 2 modules are optimized from the first training step.
sents.zh: 原始的 × 4 \times 4 路径在整个 × 2 \times 2 训练过程中保持冻结，而所有复制的 × 2 \times 2 模块则从第一步训练开始进行优化。

sents.en: The × 2 \times 2 inference path contains approximately 0.763B parameters and does not execute the original × 4 \times 4 path.
sents.zh: × 2 \times 2 推理路径包含约 0.763B 个参数，并且不会执行原始的 × 4 \times 4 路径。

paragraphs.en: Kandinsky 6.0 Video is trained in several sequential stages (Figure 5 ). Pre-training comprises three phases: separate training of the video stream, separate training of the audio stream from scratch, and joint training of both streams. Pre-training is followed by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RL-based post-training (alignment), and distillation. Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro follow the same training scheme and differ mainly in the number of steps, batch size, and learning rates; other differences are stated where they apply (e.g., the RL setup in Section 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 的训练分为多个顺序阶段（图 5）。 预训练包含三个阶段：分别对视频流进行训练、从头开始分别对音频流进行训练，以及对两种流进行联合训练。 预训练之后是监督微调（SFT）、基于强化学习的后训练（对齐）以及蒸馏。 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite 和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro 遵循相同的训练方案，主要区别在于训练步数、批量大小和学习率；其他差异在适用处均有说明（例如第 4.4 节中的强化学习设置）。

sents.en: Kandinsky 6.0 Video is trained in several sequential stages (Figure 5 ).
sents.zh: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 的训练分为多个顺序阶段（图 5）。

sents.en: Pre-training comprises three phases: separate training of the video stream, separate training of the audio stream from scratch, and joint training of both streams.
sents.zh: 预训练包含三个阶段：分别对视频流进行训练、从头开始分别对音频流进行训练，以及对两种流进行联合训练。

sents.en: Pre-training is followed by supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RL-based post-training (alignment), and distillation.
sents.zh: 预训练之后是监督微调（SFT）、基于强化学习的后训练（对齐）以及蒸馏。

sents.en: Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro follow the same training scheme and differ mainly in the number of steps, batch size, and learning rates; other differences are stated where they apply (e.g., the RL setup in Section 4.4 ).
sents.zh: Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite 和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro 遵循相同的训练方案，主要区别在于训练步数、批量大小和学习率；其他差异在适用处均有说明（例如第 4.4 节中的强化学习设置）。

paragraphs.en: All pre-training stages use flow matching [ 3 ] with an MSE loss. The audio and video streams are first trained separately and are then connected through cross-attention layers and trained jointly. The audio stream is trained from scratch, with weights randomly initialized from a normal distribution. The video stream is initialized from the corresponding Kandinsky 5.0 Video (Lite or Pro) pre-training checkpoint (SD resolution, 45k steps). At each stage, the Lite and Pro models are trained on the same data.
paragraphs.zh: 所有预训练阶段均使用流匹配 [ 3 ] 和均方误差损失。 音频流和视频流首先分别进行训练，然后通过交叉注意力层连接并联合训练。 音频流从头开始训练，其权重从正态分布中随机初始化。 视频流从对应的 Kandinsky 5.0 Video（Lite 或 Pro）预训练检查点（SD 分辨率，45k 步）进行初始化。 在每个阶段，Lite 和 Pro 模型都在相同的数据上进行训练。

sents.en: All pre-training stages use flow matching [ 3 ] with an MSE loss.
sents.zh: 所有预训练阶段均使用流匹配 [ 3 ] 和均方误差损失。

sents.en: The audio and video streams are first trained separately and are then connected through cross-attention layers and trained jointly.
sents.zh: 音频流和视频流首先分别进行训练，然后通过交叉注意力层连接并联合训练。

sents.en: The audio stream is trained from scratch, with weights randomly initialized from a normal distribution.
sents.zh: 音频流从头开始训练，其权重从正态分布中随机初始化。

sents.en: The video stream is initialized from the corresponding Kandinsky 5.0 Video (Lite or Pro) pre-training checkpoint (SD resolution, 45k steps).
sents.zh: 视频流从对应的 Kandinsky 5.0 Video（Lite 或 Pro）预训练检查点（SD 分辨率，45k 步）进行初始化。

sents.en: At each stage, the Lite and Pro models are trained on the same data.
sents.zh: 在每个阶段，Lite 和 Pro 模型都在相同的数据上进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-audio (T2A): 40k steps on T2A captions; batch size 128 × 640 128\times 640 seconds; sample length from 5 to 20 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 文本转音频（T2A）：在 T2A 字幕上执行 40k 步；批量大小为 128 × 640，耗时 128×640 秒；样本长度为 5 至 20 秒。

paragraphs.en: T2A (continued): 2k steps on T2AV captions; batch size 256 × 640 256\times 640 seconds; sample length from 5 to 20 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: T2A（续）：在 T2AV 字幕上进行 2k 步训练；批量大小为 256，时长为 640 256\times 640 秒；样本长度为 5 至 20 秒。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video (T2V), in parallel with T2A: starting from the Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite SD pre-training checkpoint (45k steps on T2V captions), 20k steps of T2V pre-training on T2AV captions; batch size 2 × 512 = 1024 2\times 512=1024 .
paragraphs.zh: 文本到视频（T2V）与 T2A 并行进行：从 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite SD 预训练检查点（在 T2V 字幕上训练了 45k 步）开始，接着在 T2AV 字幕上进行 20k 步的 T2V 预训练；批量大小为 2 × 512 = 1024。

paragraphs.en: T2A: 30k steps on T2A captions; batch size 128 × 640 128\times 640 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: T2A：在 T2A 图像说明上执行 30,000 步；批量大小为 128 × 640，耗时 128×640 秒。

paragraphs.en: T2A (continued): 4k steps on T2AV captions; batch size 256 × 640 256\times 640 seconds.
paragraphs.zh: T2A（续）：在 T2AV 字幕上运行 4k 步；批量大小为 256 × 640，耗时 256\times 640 秒。

paragraphs.en: T2V, in parallel with T2A: starting from the Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro SD pre-training checkpoint (45k steps on T2V captions), 14k steps of T2V pre-training on T2AV captions; batch size 1 × 1024 = 1024 1\times 1024=1024 .
paragraphs.zh: T2V 与 T2A 并行进行：从 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro SD 预训练检查点（在 T2V 字幕上训练了 45k 步）开始，在 T2AV 字幕上进行 14k 步的 T2V 预训练；批量大小为 1 × 1024 = 1024。

paragraphs.en: T2AV: 57.5k steps; batch size 256; up to 121 frames at 23–25 fps (at most 5 seconds of video).
paragraphs.zh: T2AV：57.5k 步；批量大小 256；最多支持 121 帧，帧率为 23–25 fps（视频时长最长为 5 秒）。

paragraphs.en: T2AV + I2AV: 4k additional steps with learning rate 1 ​ e − 5 1\mathrm{e}{-5} , with 25% of samples in I2AV mode.
paragraphs.zh: T2AV + I2AV：额外增加 4k 步，学习率设为 1\mathrm{e}{-5}，其中 25% 的样本采用 I2AV 模式。

paragraphs.en: T2AV: 46k steps with learning rate 5 ​ e − 5 5\mathrm{e}{-5} , followed by 3k steps with learning rate 2.5 ​ e − 5 2.5\mathrm{e}{-5} (49k steps in total).
paragraphs.zh: T2AV：以学习率 5 ​ e − 5 5\mathrm{e}{-5} 进行 46k 步训练，随后以学习率 2.5 ​ e − 5 2.5\mathrm{e}{-5} 进行 3k 步训练（总计 49k 步）。

paragraphs.en: T2AV + I2AV: 5k additional steps with learning rate 2.5 ​ e − 5 2.5\mathrm{e}{-5} , with 25% of samples in I2AV mode.
paragraphs.zh: T2AV + I2AV：额外增加 5k 步，学习率为 2.5​ e − 5 2.5\mathrm{e}{-5}，其中 25% 的样本采用 I2AV 模式。

paragraphs.en: During joint T2AV training, we use the independent_time mode, in which the diffusion time is sampled independently for video and audio, so that the two modalities are noised to different levels t t . This is required for audio-to-video and video-to-audio generation, where the model must take into account information from the other modality. In addition, a training batch may contain audio only, video only, images only, or video with audio; images come from the image dataset, which is also used to inject knowledge of the Russian Cultural Code (RCC). Training is performed in bfloat16 precision. Training details and hyperparameters for all continuous pre-training stages are given in Table 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 在联合 T2AV 训练期间，我们使用 independent_time 模式，其中视频和音频的扩散时间是独立采样的，因此两种模态会被噪声干扰到不同的水平 t t。 这对于音频转视频和视频转音频生成是必需的，因为模型必须考虑来自另一种模态的信息。 此外，一个训练批次可能仅包含音频、仅包含视频、仅包含图像，或同时包含视频和音频；图像来自图像数据集，该数据集也用于注入俄罗斯文化代码（RCC）的相关知识。 训练以 bfloat16 精度执行。 所有连续预训练阶段的训练细节和超参数均列于表 3 中。

sents.zh: 在联合 T2AV 训练期间，我们使用 independent_time 模式，其中视频和音频的扩散时间是独立采样的，因此两种模态会被噪声干扰到不同的水平 t t。
