sents.zh: 这对于音频转视频和视频转音频生成是必需的，因为模型必须考虑来自另一种模态的信息。

sents.en: In addition, a training batch may contain audio only, video only, images only, or video with audio; images come from the image dataset, which is also used to inject knowledge of the Russian Cultural Code (RCC).
sents.zh: 此外，一个训练批次可能仅包含音频、仅包含视频、仅包含图像，或同时包含视频和音频；图像来自图像数据集，该数据集也用于注入俄罗斯文化代码（RCC）的相关知识。

sents.en: Training is performed in bfloat16 precision.
sents.zh: 训练以 bfloat16 精度执行。

sents.en: Training details and hyperparameters for all continuous pre-training stages are given in Table 3 .
sents.zh: 所有连续预训练阶段的训练细节和超参数均列于表 3 中。

paragraphs.en: Both model versions are trained in I2AV mode with a probability of 25% during the final pre-training stage. The input scheme is compared with that of T2AV mode in Figure 6 . The latent of the conditioning frame is concatenated with the video latents along the temporal axis and receives its own temporal RoPE position. A binary channel mask distinguishes the conditioning frame (value 1) from the frames to be denoised (value 0). In addition, we introduce two learnable embeddings in the token space, the Token Role Embeddings (TRE): one for the noisy video tokens and one for the reference frame. They are added to the input tokens and provide an additional learnable signal indicating whether a token is noise or conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 在最终预训练阶段，两个模型版本均以 25% 的概率在 I2AV 模式下进行训练。 图 6 将输入方案与 T2AV 模式的输入方案进行了比较。 条件帧的潜在表示沿时间轴与视频潜在表示拼接，并获得其自身的时间 RoPE 位置。 一个二进制通道掩码用于区分条件帧（值为 1）和需要去噪的帧（值为 0）。 此外，我们在令牌空间中引入了两个可学习的嵌入——令牌角色嵌入（Token Role Embeddings, TRE）：一个用于噪声视频令牌，另一个用于参考帧。 它们被添加到输入令牌中，并提供一个额外的可学习信号，用以指示某个令牌是噪声还是条件信息。

sents.en: Both model versions are trained in I2AV mode with a probability of 25% during the final pre-training stage.
sents.zh: 在最终预训练阶段，两个模型版本均以 25% 的概率在 I2AV 模式下进行训练。

sents.en: The input scheme is compared with that of T2AV mode in Figure 6 .
sents.zh: 图 6 将输入方案与 T2AV 模式的输入方案进行了比较。

sents.en: The latent of the conditioning frame is concatenated with the video latents along the temporal axis and receives its own temporal RoPE position.
sents.zh: 条件帧的潜在表示沿时间轴与视频潜在表示拼接，并获得其自身的时间 RoPE 位置。

sents.en: A binary channel mask distinguishes the conditioning frame (value 1) from the frames to be denoised (value 0).
sents.zh: 一个二进制通道掩码用于区分条件帧（值为 1）和需要去噪的帧（值为 0）。

sents.en: In addition, we introduce two learnable embeddings in the token space, the Token Role Embeddings (TRE): one for the noisy video tokens and one for the reference frame.
sents.zh: 此外，我们在令牌空间中引入了两个可学习的嵌入——令牌角色嵌入（Token Role Embeddings, TRE）：一个用于噪声视频令牌，另一个用于参考帧。

sents.en: They are added to the input tokens and provide an additional learnable signal indicating whether a token is noise or conditioning.
sents.zh: 它们被添加到输入令牌中，并提供一个额外的可学习信号，用以指示某个令牌是噪声还是条件信息。

paragraphs.en: Inference-time ablations showed that TRE has a relatively weak effect on the result. Disabling the embeddings, or decomposing them into shared and role-specific components, changed the generations only slightly; a noticeable effect appeared only when the role-specific component was artificially amplified many times. This indicates that TRE carries discriminative information about token roles but is not the primary mechanism for recognizing the reference frame, since other cues largely duplicate its function. At the same time, inference-time ablations cannot fully determine how useful TRE is during training; this would require a separate training run without these embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: 推理时的消融实验表明，TRE 对结果的影响相对较弱。 禁用嵌入层，或将其分解为共享组件和角色特定组件，仅对生成结果产生轻微影响；只有当角色特定组件被人为多次放大时，才会出现明显效果。 这表明 TRE 携带了关于词元角色的区分性信息，但并非识别参考框架的主要机制，因为其他线索在很大程度上重复了其功能。 同时，推理时的消融实验无法完全确定 TRE 在训练期间的实际效用；这需要进行一次不包含这些嵌入层的独立训练。

sents.en: Inference-time ablations showed that TRE has a relatively weak effect on the result.
sents.zh: 推理时的消融实验表明，TRE 对结果的影响相对较弱。

sents.en: Disabling the embeddings, or decomposing them into shared and role-specific components, changed the generations only slightly; a noticeable effect appeared only when the role-specific component was artificially amplified many times.
sents.zh: 禁用嵌入层，或将其分解为共享组件和角色特定组件，仅对生成结果产生轻微影响；只有当角色特定组件被人为多次放大时，才会出现明显效果。

sents.en: This indicates that TRE carries discriminative information about token roles but is not the primary mechanism for recognizing the reference frame, since other cues largely duplicate its function.
sents.zh: 这表明 TRE 携带了关于词元角色的区分性信息，但并非识别参考框架的主要机制，因为其他线索在很大程度上重复了其功能。

sents.en: At the same time, inference-time ablations cannot fully determine how useful TRE is during training; this would require a separate training run without these embeddings.
sents.zh: 同时，推理时的消融实验无法完全确定 TRE 在训练期间的实际效用；这需要进行一次不包含这些嵌入层的独立训练。

paragraphs.en: The channel mask and the temporal RoPE had the strongest effects. Setting the mask to one for all tokens almost completely blocked denoising, whereas an all-zero mask still allowed the video to be denoised but produced artifacts, mainly in the first latent frame. Changing the temporal RoPE position of the reference frame made the model use it at the specified position: a reference with RoPE position t 4 t_{4} , t 8 t_{8} , and so on acted as a condition for the corresponding part of the video. Thus, RoPE is the primary mechanism that binds the reference frame to a position in the generated sequence, the mask explicitly separates conditioning tokens from tokens to be denoised, and TRE serves as an additional, partially redundant signal.
paragraphs.zh: 通道掩码和时间 RoPE 产生了最强的效果。 将所有标记的掩码设为 1 几乎完全阻止了去噪，而全零掩码虽然仍允许视频被去噪，但会产生伪影，主要出现在第一个潜在帧中。 改变参考帧的时间 RoPE 位置会使模型在指定位置使用它：RoPE 位置为 t 4 t_{4}、t 8 t_{8} 等的参考帧会作为视频相应部分的条件。 因此，RoPE 是将参考帧与生成序列中的某个位置绑定的主要机制，掩码明确地将条件标记与需要去噪的标记分离，而 TRE 则作为一个额外的、部分冗余的信号。

sents.en: The channel mask and the temporal RoPE had the strongest effects.
sents.zh: 通道掩码和时间 RoPE 产生了最强的效果。

sents.en: Setting the mask to one for all tokens almost completely blocked denoising, whereas an all-zero mask still allowed the video to be denoised but produced artifacts, mainly in the first latent frame.
sents.zh: 将所有标记的掩码设为 1 几乎完全阻止了去噪，而全零掩码虽然仍允许视频被去噪，但会产生伪影，主要出现在第一个潜在帧中。

sents.en: Changing the temporal RoPE position of the reference frame made the model use it at the specified position: a reference with RoPE position t 4 t_{4} , t 8 t_{8} , and so on acted as a condition for the corresponding part of the video.
sents.zh: 改变参考帧的时间 RoPE 位置会使模型在指定位置使用它：RoPE 位置为 t 4 t_{4}、t 8 t_{8} 等的参考帧会作为视频相应部分的条件。

sents.en: Thus, RoPE is the primary mechanism that binds the reference frame to a position in the generated sequence, the mask explicitly separates conditioning tokens from tokens to be denoised, and TRE serves as an additional, partially redundant signal.
sents.zh: 因此，RoPE 是将参考帧与生成序列中的某个位置绑定的主要机制，掩码明确地将条件标记与需要去噪的标记分离，而 TRE 则作为一个额外的、部分冗余的信号。

paragraphs.en: Supervised fine-tuning is performed in two stages on the SFT datasets described in Section 2 (see Table 1 ). In both stages, a separate model is fine-tuned on each of the 11 domains. The domain-specific models are trained independently through both stages and are merged into a model soup by uniform weight averaging only at the end of Stage 2. The same procedure is applied to both Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro.
paragraphs.zh: 有监督微调在章节 2 中描述的 SFT 数据集上分两个阶段进行（参见表 1）。 在这两个阶段中，每个领域都会对独立的模型进行微调。 各领域的专用模型在整个两个阶段中均独立训练，直到第二阶段结束时才通过均匀权重平均合并为模型混合体。 同样的流程也应用于 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite 和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro。

sents.en: Supervised fine-tuning is performed in two stages on the SFT datasets described in Section 2 (see Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 有监督微调在章节 2 中描述的 SFT 数据集上分两个阶段进行（参见表 1）。

sents.en: In both stages, a separate model is fine-tuned on each of the 11 domains.
sents.zh: 在这两个阶段中，每个领域都会对独立的模型进行微调。

sents.en: The domain-specific models are trained independently through both stages and are merged into a model soup by uniform weight averaging only at the end of Stage 2.
sents.zh: 各领域的专用模型在整个两个阶段中均独立训练，直到第二阶段结束时才通过均匀权重平均合并为模型混合体。

sents.en: The same procedure is applied to both Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro.
sents.zh: 同样的流程也应用于 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite 和 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 (visual quality). The goal of this stage is to improve visual quality. Training starts from the pre-trained checkpoint. The audio stream, the fusion modules, and the audio-text modules are frozen, and only the video loss is optimized: audio inputs still pass through the frozen audio stream but do not contribute to the loss. We use a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} and the same mixture of prompt detail levels as in pre-training (long: 0.7, medium: 0.15, short: 0.1, shortest: 0.05). The model is trained in T2AV and I2AV modes (75% and 25% of steps, respectively). Training is stopped after 7,000 steps, the visually best iteration before overfitting begins. To evaluate the result of this stage, the 11 domain-specific checkpoints are uniformly averaged into an intermediate Stage 1 soup. This soup is used only for quality measurement and is not used in further training.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1（视觉质量）。 本阶段的目标是提升视觉质量。 训练从预训练的检查点开始。 音频流、融合模块以及音频-文本模块保持冻结，仅优化视频损失：音频输入仍通过冻结的音频流，但不会对损失产生贡献。 我们使用学习率 1 × 10⁻⁵，并采用与预训练相同的提示细节级别混合比例（长：0.7，中：0.15，短：0.1，最短：0.05）。 模型在 T2AV 和 I2AV 模式下进行训练（分别占总步骤的 75% 和 25%）。 训练在 7,000 步后停止，此时是过拟合开始前的视觉质量最佳迭代。 为评估本阶段的结果，将 11 个领域特定的检查点均匀平均，得到阶段 1 的中间混合模型。 该混合模型仅用于质量评估，不会用于后续训练。

sents.en: Stage 1 (visual quality).
sents.zh: 阶段 1（视觉质量）。

sents.en: The goal of this stage is to improve visual quality.
sents.zh: 本阶段的目标是提升视觉质量。

sents.en: Training starts from the pre-trained checkpoint.
sents.zh: 训练从预训练的检查点开始。

sents.en: The audio stream, the fusion modules, and the audio-text modules are frozen, and only the video loss is optimized: audio inputs still pass through the frozen audio stream but do not contribute to the loss.
sents.zh: 音频流、融合模块以及音频-文本模块保持冻结，仅优化视频损失：音频输入仍通过冻结的音频流，但不会对损失产生贡献。

sents.en: We use a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} and the same mixture of prompt detail levels as in pre-training (long: 0.7, medium: 0.15, short: 0.1, shortest: 0.05).
sents.zh: 我们使用学习率 1 × 10⁻⁵，并采用与预训练相同的提示细节级别混合比例（长：0.7，中：0.15，短：0.1，最短：0.05）。

sents.en: The model is trained in T2AV and I2AV modes (75% and 25% of steps, respectively).
sents.zh: 模型在 T2AV 和 I2AV 模式下进行训练（分别占总步骤的 75% 和 25%）。

sents.en: Training is stopped after 7,000 steps, the visually best iteration before overfitting begins.
sents.zh: 训练在 7,000 步后停止，此时是过拟合开始前的视觉质量最佳迭代。

sents.en: To evaluate the result of this stage, the 11 domain-specific checkpoints are uniformly averaged into an intermediate Stage 1 soup.
sents.zh: 为评估本阶段的结果，将 11 个领域特定的检查点均匀平均，得到阶段 1 的中间混合模型。

sents.en: This soup is used only for quality measurement and is not used in further training.
sents.zh: 该混合模型仅用于质量评估，不会用于后续训练。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 (synchronization and lip-sync). This stage improves audio-video synchronization, with particular emphasis on lip-sync. Training continues separately from each domain-specific Stage 1 checkpoint rather than from the Stage 1 soup. All modules are unfrozen and trained with different learning rates: 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for the video stream and the shared modules and 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} for the audio components. The loss is a weighted sum of the video loss (weight 0.85), the audio loss (0.15), and a new face loss (1.0). The face loss is the video loss restricted to the facial region in the latent space; it encourages more accurate lip-sync. As in Stage 1, 75% of steps are in T2AV mode and 25% in I2AV mode. After 5,000 steps, the 11 domain-specific checkpoints are uniformly averaged to obtain the final SFT model.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 阶段（同步与口型同步）。 此阶段可改善音频与视频的同步效果，尤其注重口型同步。 训练从每个领域特定的第 1 阶段检查点单独继续，而非从第 1 阶段的混合模型开始。 所有模块均被解冻，并以不同的学习率进行训练：视频流和共享模块的学习率为 1 × 10⁻⁵，音频组件的学习率为 1 × 10⁻⁶。 损失函数是视频损失（权重 0.85）、音频损失（0.15）以及新的面部损失（1.0）的加权总和。 面部损失是将视频损失限制在潜在空间中面部区域的损失；它能促进更精确的口型同步。 与第 1 阶段一样，75% 的步骤采用 T2AV 模式，25% 采用 I2AV 模式。 经过 5,000 步训练后，将 11 个领域特定的检查点均匀平均，以获得最终的 SFT 模型。

sents.en: Stage 2 (synchronization and lip-sync).
sents.zh: 第 2 阶段（同步与口型同步）。

sents.en: This stage improves audio-video synchronization, with particular emphasis on lip-sync.
sents.zh: 此阶段可改善音频与视频的同步效果，尤其注重口型同步。

sents.en: Training continues separately from each domain-specific Stage 1 checkpoint rather than from the Stage 1 soup.
sents.zh: 训练从每个领域特定的第 1 阶段检查点单独继续，而非从第 1 阶段的混合模型开始。

sents.en: All modules are unfrozen and trained with different learning rates: 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} for the video stream and the shared modules and 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} for the audio components.
sents.zh: 所有模块均被解冻，并以不同的学习率进行训练：视频流和共享模块的学习率为 1 × 10⁻⁵，音频组件的学习率为 1 × 10⁻⁶。

sents.en: The loss is a weighted sum of the video loss (weight 0.85), the audio loss (0.15), and a new face loss (1.0).
sents.zh: 损失函数是视频损失（权重 0.85）、音频损失（0.15）以及新的面部损失（1.0）的加权总和。

sents.en: The face loss is the video loss restricted to the facial region in the latent space; it encourages more accurate lip-sync.
sents.zh: 面部损失是将视频损失限制在潜在空间中面部区域的损失；它能促进更精确的口型同步。

sents.en: As in Stage 1, 75% of steps are in T2AV mode and 25% in I2AV mode.
sents.zh: 与第 1 阶段一样，75% 的步骤采用 T2AV 模式，25% 采用 I2AV 模式。

sents.en: After 5,000 steps, the 11 domain-specific checkpoints are uniformly averaged to obtain the final SFT model.
sents.zh: 经过 5,000 步训练后，将 11 个领域特定的检查点均匀平均，以获得最终的 SFT 模型。

paragraphs.en: For RL post-training, we adapt the OmniNFT method [ 24 ] , originally developed for LTX-2 19B, to the Kandinsky 6.0 Video backbone. The approach combines modality-wise advantage routing, layer-wise gradient surgery, and region-wise loss reweighting. The reward phase and the training phase are illustrated in Figures 7 and 8 , respectively. A side-by-side comparison of the RL and SFT checkpoints is given in Section 7.2.9 .

paragraphs.en: Each raw reward is first converted into an advantage: it is centered by its mean within the rollout group and scaled by the batch-wide standard deviation, floored at 0.1 0.1 to avoid advantage blow-up in near-uniform groups. The weighted advantages are then summed into two branch-aware advantages, one per modality. The sync-branch terms (AV-desync, AV-align, LatentSync-gated) are added to both the video and the audio advantages. Both advantages are clamped to [ − 5 , 5 ] [-5,5] for stability. The per-modality advantages are then broadcast to per-token rewards: the video advantage over the latent video token grid H v × W v × L v H_{v}\times W_{v}\times L_{v} and the audio advantage over the L a L_{a} audio tokens. Each is rescaled to r token = clamp ⁡ ( ( adv / 5 + 1 ) / 2 , 0 , 1 ) r_{\text{token}}=\mathrm{clamp}((\mathrm{adv}/5+1)/2,\,0,\,1) before being used in the policy update.
paragraphs.zh: 每个原始奖励首先被转换为一个优势值：通过其在展开组内的均值进行中心化，并通过整个批次的标准差进行缩放，同时将其下限设为 0.1，以避免在近乎均匀的组中优势值爆炸。 随后，加权优势值被汇总为两个感知分支的优势值，每个模态各一个。 同步分支项（AV-desync、AV-align、LatentSync-gated）被添加到视频和音频优势值中。 为了保持稳定，两个优势值都被限制在 [−5, 5] 范围内。 接着，每个模态的优势值被广播到每个标记的奖励上：视频优势值对应于潜在视频标记网格 H v × W v × L v，而音频优势值则对应于 L a 个音频标记。 在使用它们进行策略更新之前，每个优势值都会被重新缩放为 r token = clamp ⁡ ( ( adv / 5 + 1 ) / 2 , 0 , 1)。

paragraphs.en: We use GRPO groups of K = 10 K=10 rollouts per prompt. Rollouts are generated at 512 × 768 512\times 768 resolution with 31 31 latent frames (121 frames, 5 s at 24 fps), using the DPM2 solver with 20 20 steps, CFG = 1.0 \mathrm{CFG}=1.0 , and noise level 0 0 . With these settings, the sampler is deterministic, so the random seed is the only source of diversity within a group. Note that RL is performed at a lower spatial resolution than Full-HD inference. The model is fine-tuned with LoRA ( r = 16 r=16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 ) on top of the frozen SFT model. LoRA is applied to every linear layer inside the transformer blocks of both streams — self-attention, text cross-attention, feed-forward, and both cross-modal attention modules (Q, K, V, and output projections); text, time, and modulation embeddings are not adapted. This amounts to 0.69% of the parameters for Pro (199M) and 1.57% for Lite (47M). The LoRA is trained from scratch, without a warm-start checkpoint or transferred optimizer state.

paragraphs.en: We do not take the last training epoch as the final RL checkpoint. Instead, we track the weighted sum of rewards during training and select the checkpoint with the best average over a sliding window of 5 epochs, which avoids picking a single lucky iteration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不将最后一个训练周期视为最终的强化学习检查点。 相反，我们追踪训练过程中的奖励加权和，并选择在过去 5 个周期滑动窗口内平均表现最佳的检查点，从而避免仅因单次幸运迭代而做出选择。

paragraphs.en: Layer-wise gradient surgery. To prevent video-branch gradients from disrupting audio representations, we scale down the gradients on the key-value path of the V2A cross-attention, in which video queries attend to audio keys and values (Figure 1 ). The production Pro model uses a data-driven per-block schedule: scale 0.0 for block 0, 0.1 for blocks 1–10, and 0.3 for blocks 50–59 (a deep AV-sync zone identified by KV ablation), while blocks 11–49 are left unscaled (scale 1.0). For Lite (32 blocks) the recalibrated schedule is 0.0 for block 0, 0.1 for blocks 1–5, and 0.3 for blocks 22–26. The zones reported for LTX-2 did not transfer directly to our models, so we calibrated these schedules with our own probes: blockwise ablation of the cross-modal key–value input (measuring the resulting audio–video desynchronization) and measurement of the video-loss gradient leaking into the audio stream.
paragraphs.zh: 逐层梯度手术。 为防止视频分支的梯度干扰音频表示，我们对 V2A 交叉注意力中键值路径上的梯度进行了缩放，其中视频查询会关注音频键和值（图 1）。 生产版 Pro 模型采用数据驱动的分块调度方案：第 0 块的缩放系数为 0.0，第 1–10 块的缩放系数为 0.1，第 50–59 块的缩放系数为 0.3（这是通过 KV 消融分析确定的深度音视频同步区域），而第 11–49 块则保持未缩放（缩放系数为 1.0）。 对于 Lite 版本（32 个块），重新校准后的调度方案为：第 0 块的缩放系数为 0.0，第 1–5 块的缩放系数为 0.1，第 22–26 块的缩放系数为 0.3。 LTX-2 中报告的区域无法直接迁移到我们的模型中，因此我们使用自己的探针对这些调度方案进行了校准：通过逐块消融跨模态键值输入（测量由此产生的音视频不同步现象），并测量视频损失梯度向音频流中的泄漏情况。

sents.en: Layer-wise gradient surgery.
sents.zh: 逐层梯度手术。

paragraphs.en: Region-wise loss reweighting. The weights attn_w used in the policy aggregation are derived from the attention maps of the A2V cross-attention, in which audio queries attend to video keys and values, sampled at a subset of denoising steps. Video patches that receive stronger attention from audio tokens (typically faces, hands, and musical instruments) are assigned higher weights. The reweighting factor is capped at 1.5 × \times and is mapped from the DiT patch grid to the pre-patch loss grid by spatial unpatchifying.
paragraphs.zh: 按区域重加权损失。 策略聚合中使用的权重 attn_w 源自 A2V 交叉注意力的注意力图，其中音频查询关注视频键和值，这些键和值在去噪步骤的子集中进行采样。 从音频标记接收到更强注意力的视频块（通常是面部、手和乐器）会被分配更高的权重。 重加权因子上限为 1.5 × \times，并通过空间反分块操作从 DiT 块网格映射到预块损失网格。

sents.en: Region-wise loss reweighting.
sents.zh: 按区域重加权损失。

paragraphs.en: RL post-training substantially improves speech intelligibility. For Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro, the word error rate (WER) on a held-out speech benchmark (64 prompts, 3 seeds each) decreases from 0.235 for the SFT model to 0.124, a relative reduction of 47% (paired Wilcoxon test, p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ); for Lite it decreases from 0.179 to 0.127 ( − 29 % -29\% , p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ). WER is computed with Whisper-large-v3, which is also one of the reward models; the gain is confirmed on the public Harvard sentences (100 prompts), where Pro WER drops from 0.251 to 0.180 ( p = 0.005 p=0.005 ).
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）的后训练显著提升了语音的可理解性。 对于 Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro，在预留的语音基准数据集（64 个提示，每个提示使用 3 个种子）上的词错误率（WER）从 SFT 模型的 0.235 降至 0.124，相对降低了 47%（配对威尔科克森检验，p < 10⁻³）；对于 Lite 版本，该指标从 0.179 降至 0.127（−29%，p < 10⁻³）。 WER 使用 Whisper-large-v3 计算，该模型同时也是奖励模型之一；这一提升在公开的 Harvard 句子数据集（100 个提示）上也得到了验证，Pro 版本的 WER 从 0.251 降至 0.180（p = 0.005）。

sents.en: RL post-training substantially improves speech intelligibility.
sents.zh: 强化学习（RL）的后训练显著提升了语音的可理解性。

sents.en: For Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro, the word error rate (WER) on a held-out speech benchmark (64 prompts, 3 seeds each) decreases from 0.235 for the SFT model to 0.124, a relative reduction of 47% (paired Wilcoxon test, p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ); for Lite it decreases from 0.179 to 0.127 ( − 29 % -29\% , p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ).

sents.zh: WER 使用 Whisper-large-v3 计算，该模型同时也是奖励模型之一；这一提升在公开的 Harvard 句子数据集（100 个提示）上也得到了验证，Pro 版本的 WER 从 0.251 降至 0.180（p = 0.005）。

paragraphs.en: Following Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ] , we split distillation into two complementary stages:
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Kandinsky 5.0 [ 11 ] 的方法，我们将蒸馏过程分为两个互补的阶段：

paragraphs.en: Trajectory distillation: the teacher’s sampling trajectory is compressed into a few-step student.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹蒸馏：将教师的采样轨迹压缩为少数步骤的学生模型。

paragraphs.en: Quality improvement: the perceptual fidelity lost during aggressive trajectory compression is recovered using real data and adversarial training.
paragraphs.zh: 质量改进：通过真实数据和对抗性训练，恢复在激进轨迹压缩过程中损失的感知保真度。

paragraphs.en: For trajectory distillation, we evaluated several families of methods: DMD [ 52 ] , DMD2 [ 53 ] , SID [ 54 ] , Phased Consistency [ 55 ] , CFG distillation [ 56 ] , π \pi -Flow [ 57 ] , and Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) [ 58 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在轨迹蒸馏方面，我们评估了多种方法家族：DMD [ 52 ]、DMD2 [ 53 ]、SID [ 54 ]、Phased Consistency [ 55 ]、CFG distillation [ 56 ]、π \pi -Flow [ 57 ] 以及 Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) [ 58 ]。

paragraphs.en: Distribution-matching methods (DMD, DMD2, SID) provide a direct objective for aligning the student and teacher distributions, but in our experiments they were prone to mode collapse and mode dropping. They also required substantially more GPUs because of expensive teacher evaluations, auxiliary score estimation, and optimization overhead. This cost is especially high for video, whose spatio-temporal latents are far more expensive to process than those of images.
paragraphs.zh: 分布匹配方法（DMD、DMD2、SID）为对齐学生和教师分布提供了直接的目标，但在我们的实验中，这些方法容易出现模式坍缩和模式缺失的问题。 由于教师评估、辅助分数估计和优化开销高昂，这些方法还需要大量更多的 GPU。 对于视频而言，这种成本尤其高，因为其时空潜在变量的处理成本远高于图像的潜在变量。

sents.en: Distribution-matching methods (DMD, DMD2, SID) provide a direct objective for aligning the student and teacher distributions, but in our experiments they were prone to mode collapse and mode dropping.
sents.zh: 分布匹配方法（DMD、DMD2、SID）为对齐学生和教师分布提供了直接的目标，但在我们的实验中，这些方法容易出现模式坍缩和模式缺失的问题。

sents.en: They also required substantially more GPUs because of expensive teacher evaluations, auxiliary score estimation, and optimization overhead.
sents.zh: 由于教师评估、辅助分数估计和优化开销高昂，这些方法还需要大量更多的 GPU。

sents.en: This cost is especially high for video, whose spatio-temporal latents are far more expensive to process than those of images.
sents.zh: 对于视频而言，这种成本尤其高，因为其时空潜在变量的处理成本远高于图像的潜在变量。

paragraphs.en: CFG distillation and consistency-based methods are simple and effective baselines, but we observed that they can alter the teacher’s generation behavior, including motion dynamics and the distribution of generated samples. They remained useful but were not flexible or performant enough for our few-step video generation setting.
paragraphs.zh: CFG 蒸馏和基于一致性的方法虽然简单且有效，但我们的观察表明，它们可能会改变教师的生成行为，包括运动动态和生成样本的分布。 这些方法仍然有用，但对于我们这种少步视频生成的场景而言，灵活性和性能都还不够。

sents.en: CFG distillation and consistency-based methods are simple and effective baselines, but we observed that they can alter the teacher’s generation behavior, including motion dynamics and the distribution of generated samples.
sents.zh: CFG 蒸馏和基于一致性的方法虽然简单且有效，但我们的观察表明，它们可能会改变教师的生成行为，包括运动动态和生成样本的分布。

sents.en: They remained useful but were not flexible or performant enough for our few-step video generation setting.
sents.zh: 这些方法仍然有用，但对于我们这种少步视频生成的场景而言，灵活性和性能都还不够。

paragraphs.en: We then evaluated two more recent trajectory-based methods, π \pi -Flow and PDD. Of these, π \pi -Flow showed the most reliable convergence and the best preservation of the teacher trajectory. Its imitation-learning formulation trains the student on-policy, i.e., on the states encountered during the student’s own rollout, which is the same distribution the student faces at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，我们评估了另外两种较新的基于轨迹的方法：π \pi -Flow 和 PDD。 其中，π \pi -Flow 表现出最可靠的收敛性和对教师轨迹的最佳保留能力。 其模仿学习框架以策略方式训练学生智能体，即基于学生在自身执行过程中遇到的状态进行训练，而这些状态与学生在推理阶段所面对的状态分布相同。

sents.en: We then evaluated two more recent trajectory-based methods, π \pi -Flow and PDD.
sents.zh: 接着，我们评估了另外两种较新的基于轨迹的方法：π \pi -Flow 和 PDD。

sents.en: Of these, π \pi -Flow showed the most reliable convergence and the best preservation of the teacher trajectory.
sents.zh: 其中，π \pi -Flow 表现出最可靠的收敛性和对教师轨迹的最佳保留能力。

sents.en: Its imitation-learning formulation trains the student on-policy, i.e., on the states encountered during the student’s own rollout, which is the same distribution the student faces at inference.
sents.zh: 其模仿学习框架以策略方式训练学生智能体，即基于学生在自身执行过程中遇到的状态进行训练，而这些状态与学生在推理阶段所面对的状态分布相同。

paragraphs.en: As with DMD, the quality of π \pi -Flow is ultimately bounded by the teacher. Unlike distribution-matching methods, however, it avoids an aggressively mode-seeking objective: it encourages the student to reproduce the teacher’s local decisions along the trajectory, which substantially reduces mode collapse and mode dropping. The guided teacher trajectory can also be distilled directly, which removes the need for a separate CFG distillation stage. For these reasons, we chose π \pi -Flow for trajectory distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 与 DMD 类似，π-Flow 的质量最终受限于教师智能体。 然而，与分布匹配方法不同，它避免了过度追求特定模式的优化目标：它鼓励学生智能体沿轨迹复现教师智能体的局部决策，从而显著减少模式坍缩和模式缺失。 引导性的教师轨迹也可以直接进行蒸馏，从而无需单独的 CFG 蒸馏阶段。 基于这些原因，我们选择了 π-Flow 来进行轨迹蒸馏。

sents.en: As with DMD, the quality of π \pi -Flow is ultimately bounded by the teacher.
sents.zh: 与 DMD 类似，π-Flow 的质量最终受限于教师智能体。

sents.en: Unlike distribution-matching methods, however, it avoids an aggressively mode-seeking objective: it encourages the student to reproduce the teacher’s local decisions along the trajectory, which substantially reduces mode collapse and mode dropping.
sents.zh: 然而，与分布匹配方法不同，它避免了过度追求特定模式的优化目标：它鼓励学生智能体沿轨迹复现教师智能体的局部决策，从而显著减少模式坍缩和模式缺失。

sents.en: The guided teacher trajectory can also be distilled directly, which removes the need for a separate CFG distillation stage.
sents.zh: 引导性的教师轨迹也可以直接进行蒸馏，从而无需单独的 CFG 蒸馏阶段。

sents.en: For these reasons, we chose π \pi -Flow for trajectory distillation.
sents.zh: 基于这些原因，我们选择了 π-Flow 来进行轨迹蒸馏。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory compression alone does not fully preserve model quality: as the number of sampling steps decreases, generated videos become smoother and less detailed. This effect grows with more aggressive compression even when the semantic composition and global motion remain correct: the student loses high-frequency texture, local contrast, and fine spatial detail.
paragraphs.zh: 仅通过轨迹压缩并不能完全保留模型质量：随着采样步数的减少，生成的视频会变得更平滑，但细节也会更少。 当语义构图和全局运动仍然正确时，更激进的压缩会使这种效应更加明显：学生模型会失去高频纹理、局部对比度和精细的空间细节。

sents.en: Trajectory compression alone does not fully preserve model quality: as the number of sampling steps decreases, generated videos become smoother and less detailed.
sents.zh: 仅通过轨迹压缩并不能完全保留模型质量：随着采样步数的减少，生成的视频会变得更平滑，但细节也会更少。

sents.en: This effect grows with more aggressive compression even when the semantic composition and global motion remain correct: the student loses high-frequency texture, local contrast, and fine spatial detail.
sents.zh: 当语义构图和全局运动仍然正确时，更激进的压缩会使这种效应更加明显：学生模型会失去高频纹理、局部对比度和精细的空间细节。

paragraphs.en: Additional trajectory matching does not reliably fix this degradation. Therefore, the second stage uses real data and an adversarial objective to restore perceptual fidelity. We build on LADD [ 59 ] and introduce Simulated LADD (Sim-LADD), which aims to improve the realism of samples from the trajectory-compressed student.
paragraphs.zh: 额外的轨迹匹配无法可靠地解决这种性能下降问题。 因此，第二阶段使用真实数据和对抗性目标来恢复感知保真度。 我们在 LADD [59] 的基础上进行了改进，并提出了 Simulated LADD（Sim-LADD），旨在提升来自轨迹压缩学生模型的样本的真实性。

sents.en: Additional trajectory matching does not reliably fix this degradation.
sents.zh: 额外的轨迹匹配无法可靠地解决这种性能下降问题。

sents.en: Therefore, the second stage uses real data and an adversarial objective to restore perceptual fidelity.
sents.zh: 因此，第二阶段使用真实数据和对抗性目标来恢复感知保真度。

sents.en: We build on LADD [ 59 ] and introduce Simulated LADD (Sim-LADD), which aims to improve the realism of samples from the trajectory-compressed student.
sents.zh: 我们在 LADD [59] 的基础上进行了改进，并提出了 Simulated LADD（Sim-LADD），旨在提升来自轨迹压缩学生模型的样本的真实性。

paragraphs.en: In standard LADD, the intermediate state x t x_{t} used for adversarial training is obtained via the forward noising process. Following the on-policy formulation of DMD2, Sim-LADD instead obtains x t x_{t} from the student’s own backward denoising rollout, so the discriminator sees the states actually encountered at inference, which reduces the train–inference gap.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准的 LADD 中，用于对抗性训练的中间状态 x t x_{t} 是通过前向加噪过程获得的。 遵循 DMD2 的在线策略形式，Sim-LADD 则从学生模型自身的反向去噪展开过程中获取 x t x_{t}，因此判别器能够看到推理阶段实际遇到的状态，从而缩小训练与推理之间的差距。

sents.en: In standard LADD, the intermediate state x t x_{t} used for adversarial training is obtained via the forward noising process.
sents.zh: 在标准的 LADD 中，用于对抗性训练的中间状态 x t x_{t} 是通过前向加噪过程获得的。

sents.en: Following the on-policy formulation of DMD2, Sim-LADD instead obtains x t x_{t} from the student’s own backward denoising rollout, so the discriminator sees the states actually encountered at inference, which reduces the train–inference gap.
sents.zh: 遵循 DMD2 的在线策略形式，Sim-LADD 则从学生模型自身的反向去噪展开过程中获取 x t x_{t}，因此判别器能够看到推理阶段实际遇到的状态，从而缩小训练与推理之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: Following DRaFT [ 60 ] , the adversarial gradient can be propagated through the complete differentiable denoising chain rather than only through the final sample or a single transition. In practice, truncated backpropagation through the final k k solver steps (DRaFT- k k ) provided comparable quality at a substantially lower memory cost. We therefore use k = 5 k=5 , i.e., half of the student’s 10 NFE.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 DRaFT [ 60 ]，对抗性梯度可以通过整个可微分去噪链进行传播，而不仅仅是通过最终样本或单个过渡步骤。 在实践中，通过最后 k 个求解器步骤进行的截断反向传播（DRaFT-k）在显著降低内存成本的同时，提供了相当接近的质量。 因此，我们使用 k = 5，即学生模型 10 NFE 的一半。

sents.en: Following DRaFT [ 60 ] , the adversarial gradient can be propagated through the complete differentiable denoising chain rather than only through the final sample or a single transition.
sents.zh: 遵循 DRaFT [ 60 ]，对抗性梯度可以通过整个可微分去噪链进行传播，而不仅仅是通过最终样本或单个过渡步骤。

sents.en: In practice, truncated backpropagation through the final k k solver steps (DRaFT- k k ) provided comparable quality at a substantially lower memory cost.
sents.zh: 在实践中，通过最后 k 个求解器步骤进行的截断反向传播（DRaFT-k）在显著降低内存成本的同时，提供了相当接近的质量。

sents.en: We therefore use k = 5 k=5 , i.e., half of the student’s 10 NFE.
sents.zh: 因此，我们使用 k = 5，即学生模型 10 NFE 的一半。

paragraphs.en: We distill the teacher into a few-step student that requires only 10 10 function evaluations (NFEs). Among the methods we tried, π \pi -Flow gave the best convergence, motion and audio fidelity, and trajectory alignment, without mode collapse. Because it formulates trajectory distillation as on-policy imitation learning, it directly absorbs the teacher’s CFG-guided trajectory, which removes the need for a separate CFG distillation stage.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将教师模型提炼为一个只需 10 次函数评估（NFE）的多步学生模型。 在我们尝试的方法中，π \pi -Flow 在收敛性、运动与音频保真度以及轨迹对齐方面表现最佳，且没有出现模式坍塌。 由于它将轨迹提炼表述为在线策略模仿学习，因此可以直接吸收教师模型由 CFG 引导的轨迹，从而无需单独的 CFG 提炼阶段。

sents.en: We distill the teacher into a few-step student that requires only 10 10 function evaluations (NFEs).
sents.zh: 我们将教师模型提炼为一个只需 10 次函数评估（NFE）的多步学生模型。

sents.en: Among the methods we tried, π \pi -Flow gave the best convergence, motion and audio fidelity, and trajectory alignment, without mode collapse.
sents.zh: 在我们尝试的方法中，π \pi -Flow 在收敛性、运动与音频保真度以及轨迹对齐方面表现最佳，且没有出现模式坍塌。

sents.en: Because it formulates trajectory distillation as on-policy imitation learning, it directly absorbs the teacher’s CFG-guided trajectory, which removes the need for a separate CFG distillation stage.
sents.zh: 由于它将轨迹提炼表述为在线策略模仿学习，因此可以直接吸收教师模型由 CFG 引导的轨迹，从而无需单独的 CFG 提炼阶段。

paragraphs.en: The trajectory-compressed student shows textural and perceptual degradation caused by the coarse discretization of the sampling trajectory. We refine this checkpoint with Sim-LADD: unlike standard LADD, which builds training states via forward diffusion, Sim-LADD uses actual backward rollouts of the student, which reduces the train–inference mismatch (Figure 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 经过轨迹压缩的学生模型因采样轨迹的粗略离散化而表现出纹理和感知方面的退化。 我们通过 Sim-LADD 对该检查点进行了优化：与通过前向扩散构建训练状态的常规 LADD 不同，Sim-LADD 使用学生模型的实际反向展开过程，从而减少了训练与推理之间的不匹配（图 9）。

sents.en: The trajectory-compressed student shows textural and perceptual degradation caused by the coarse discretization of the sampling trajectory.
sents.zh: 经过轨迹压缩的学生模型因采样轨迹的粗略离散化而表现出纹理和感知方面的退化。

sents.en: We refine this checkpoint with Sim-LADD: unlike standard LADD, which builds training states via forward diffusion, Sim-LADD uses actual backward rollouts of the student, which reduces the train–inference mismatch (Figure 9 ).
sents.zh: 我们通过 Sim-LADD 对该检查点进行了优化：与通过前向扩散构建训练状态的常规 LADD 不同，Sim-LADD 使用学生模型的实际反向展开过程，从而减少了训练与推理之间的不匹配（图 9）。

paragraphs.en: We backpropagate the adversarial gradient through the final k k sampling steps, following DRaFT- k k . As in the original LADD, we apply stochastic re-noising to both real and generated latents before discriminator feature extraction. This stabilizes adversarial training, reduces discriminator overfitting, and removes the need for an explicit R 1 R_{1} gradient penalty such as the one used in APT [ 61 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照 DRaFT-kk 的方法，通过最后 k 个采样步骤反向传播对抗梯度。 与原始 LADD 一样，在提取判别器特征之前，我们对真实和生成的潜在变量都应用随机重噪声处理。 这能稳定对抗训练，减少判别器的过拟合，并消除了对显式 R₁ 梯度惩罚（如 APT [61] 中所用）的需求。

sents.en: We backpropagate the adversarial gradient through the final k k sampling steps, following DRaFT- k k .
sents.zh: 我们按照 DRaFT-kk 的方法，通过最后 k 个采样步骤反向传播对抗梯度。

sents.en: As in the original LADD, we apply stochastic re-noising to both real and generated latents before discriminator feature extraction.
sents.zh: 与原始 LADD 一样，在提取判别器特征之前，我们对真实和生成的潜在变量都应用随机重噪声处理。

sents.en: This stabilizes adversarial training, reduces discriminator overfitting, and removes the need for an explicit R 1 R_{1} gradient penalty such as the one used in APT [ 61 ] .
sents.zh: 这能稳定对抗训练，减少判别器的过拟合，并消除了对显式 R₁ 梯度惩罚（如 APT [61] 中所用）的需求。

paragraphs.en: The two stages play complementary roles: π \pi -Flow performs stable trajectory compression while preserving the teacher’s semantics, motion, and diversity, and Sim-LADD then uses real data and adversarial learning to recover the high-frequency detail and perceptual sharpness lost during compression.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个阶段发挥着互补的作用：π \pi -Flow 在执行稳定的轨迹压缩时，同时保留了教师模型所蕴含的语义、运动和多样性；随后，Sim-LADD 利用真实数据和对抗性学习，恢复压缩过程中丢失的高频细节和感知清晰度。

paragraphs.en: The student policy network is initialized directly from the pretrained teacher backbone and optimized with an on-policy imitation ℓ 2 \ell_{2} regression objective against the guided teacher velocity field.
paragraphs.zh: 学生策略网络直接从预训练的教师骨干网络初始化，并通过基于策略的模仿 ℓ₂ \ell_{2} 回归目标，针对引导教师的速度场进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Following the policy schedule described in π \pi -Flow [ 57 ] , training proceeds through three regimes: an off-policy phase for stable initial convergence to the teacher distribution, followed by a mixed policy phase that prepares the student for on-policy training and lastly the on-policy phase that corrects the train–inference mismatch. We train for 4 4 k iterations, with the three regimes in a : : 2 1\!:\!1\!:\!2 ratio.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 π \pi -Flow [ 57 ] 中描述的策略调度，训练分为三个阶段：首先进行离策略阶段，以实现向教师分布的稳定初始收敛；接着是混合策略阶段，用于为学生模型做好进入在策略训练的准备；最后是在策略阶段，用以修正训练与推理之间的不匹配问题。 我们进行 4 个 k 次迭代训练，三个阶段的比例为 : : 2 1\!:\!1\!:\!2。

sents.en: Following the policy schedule described in π \pi -Flow [ 57 ] , training proceeds through three regimes: an off-policy phase for stable initial convergence to the teacher distribution, followed by a mixed policy phase that prepares the student for on-policy training and lastly the on-policy phase that corrects the train–inference mismatch.
sents.zh: 遵循 π \pi -Flow [ 57 ] 中描述的策略调度，训练分为三个阶段：首先进行离策略阶段，以实现向教师分布的稳定初始收敛；接着是混合策略阶段，用于为学生模型做好进入在策略训练的准备；最后是在策略阶段，用以修正训练与推理之间的不匹配问题。

sents.en: We train for 4 4 k iterations, with the three regimes in a : : 2 1\!:\!1\!:\!2 ratio.
sents.zh: 我们进行 4 个 k 次迭代训练，三个阶段的比例为 : : 2 1\!:\!1\!:\!2。

paragraphs.en: Student trajectory discretized into N = 10 N=10 uniform integration intervals (10 NFE).
paragraphs.zh: 学生轨迹被离散化为 N = 10 N=10 个均匀积分区间（10 NFE）。

paragraphs.en: The resulting checkpoint initializes the adversarial refinement stage.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的检查点会初始化对抗性优化阶段。

paragraphs.en: Adversarial refinement uses a hinge loss computed on multi-scale latent features extracted from intermediate layers of the frozen teacher backbone. Following APT [ 61 ] , all discriminator parameters are updated during training. The discriminator heads are implemented as Fused Transformer Decoder blocks (Figure 10 ). Image-conditioning tokens are removed from the feature sequence before the discriminator logits are computed. During the backward student rollout, gradients are propagated through the final k = 5 k=5 solver steps, and gradient checkpointing keeps peak GPU memory consumption manageable.
paragraphs.zh: 对抗性精修使用在冻结教师骨干网络中间层中提取的多尺度潜在特征上计算的铰链损失。 遵循 APT [ 61 ]，所有判别器参数都会在训练期间进行更新。 判别器头被实现为融合 Transformer 解码器模块（图 10）。 在计算判别器 logits 之前，图像条件化标记会从特征序列中移除。 在反向学生展开过程中，梯度会通过最后 k = 5 个求解步骤传播，而梯度检查点机制则使峰值 GPU 内存消耗保持在可控范围内。

sents.en: Adversarial refinement uses a hinge loss computed on multi-scale latent features extracted from intermediate layers of the frozen teacher backbone.

sents.en: Following APT [ 61 ] , all discriminator parameters are updated during training.
sents.zh: 遵循 APT [ 61 ]，所有判别器参数都会在训练期间进行更新。

sents.en: The discriminator heads are implemented as Fused Transformer Decoder blocks (Figure 10 ).
sents.zh: 判别器头被实现为融合 Transformer 解码器模块（图 10）。

sents.en: Image-conditioning tokens are removed from the feature sequence before the discriminator logits are computed.
sents.zh: 在计算判别器 logits 之前，图像条件化标记会从特征序列中移除。

sents.en: During the backward student rollout, gradients are propagated through the final k = 5 k=5 solver steps, and gradient checkpointing keeps peak GPU memory consumption manageable.
sents.zh: 在反向学生展开过程中，梯度会通过最后 k = 5 个求解步骤传播，而梯度检查点机制则使峰值 GPU 内存消耗保持在可控范围内。

paragraphs.en: Both real and generated latents are perturbed with a stochastic re-noising schedule: before discriminator feature extraction, noise levels are sampled from a fixed LogitNormal ⁡ ( − 3.5 , 1.0 ) \operatorname{LogitNormal}(-3.5,1.0) distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 真实和生成的潜在变量都通过一个随机重加噪方案进行扰动：在判别器特征提取之前，噪声水平从固定的 LogitNormal⁡(−3.5, 1.0) \operatorname{LogitNormal}(-3.5,1.0) 分布中采样。

paragraphs.en: Optimizer: AdamW for both the generator and the discriminator;
paragraphs.zh: 优化器：生成器和判别器均使用 AdamW；

Gradient clipping: maximum norm 1.0 1.0 ;

paragraphs.en: A single SR-DiT model is trained jointly for × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 video super-resolution, using training pairs from both scales with equal sampling probability. The SR-DiT and the Latent Upscalers (LU), trained separately for each scale, are optimized independently.
paragraphs.zh: 单个 SR-DiT 模型被联合训练用于 ×2 \times 2 和 ×4 \times 4 的视频超分辨率，使用来自两种尺度的训练对，并以相等的采样概率进行训练。 SR-DiT 和潜在上采样器（LU）分别针对每种尺度进行训练，并且是独立优化的。

sents.en: A single SR-DiT model is trained jointly for × 2 \times 2 and × 4 \times 4 video super-resolution, using training pairs from both scales with equal sampling probability.
sents.zh: 单个 SR-DiT 模型被联合训练用于 ×2 \times 2 和 ×4 \times 4 的视频超分辨率，使用来自两种尺度的训练对，并以相等的采样概率进行训练。

sents.en: The SR-DiT and the Latent Upscalers (LU), trained separately for each scale, are optimized independently.
sents.zh: SR-DiT 和潜在上采样器（LU）分别针对每种尺度进行训练，并且是独立优化的。

paragraphs.en: During SR-DiT training, the degraded LQ and HQ latents have matching spatial dimensions. For Real-ESRGAN-style degradations, this is achieved by bilinearly upsampling the low-resolution clip in pixel space before K-VAE encoding. The temporal degradation pipeline directly produces a degraded clip at the HQ resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SR-DiT 训练过程中，降质的 LQ 和 HQ 潜在表示具有匹配的空间维度。 对于 Real-ESRGAN 风格的降质处理，这是通过在 K-VAE 编码之前，在像素空间中对低分辨率片段进行双线性上采样来实现的。 时间维度上的降质流程会直接生成一个 HQ 分辨率的降质片段。

sents.en: During SR-DiT training, the degraded LQ and HQ latents have matching spatial dimensions.
sents.zh: 在 SR-DiT 训练过程中，降质的 LQ 和 HQ 潜在表示具有匹配的空间维度。

sents.en: For Real-ESRGAN-style degradations, this is achieved by bilinearly upsampling the low-resolution clip in pixel space before K-VAE encoding.
sents.zh: 对于 Real-ESRGAN 风格的降质处理，这是通过在 K-VAE 编码之前，在像素空间中对低分辨率片段进行双线性上采样来实现的。

sents.en: The temporal degradation pipeline directly produces a degraded clip at the HQ resolution.
sents.zh: 时间维度上的降质流程会直接生成一个 HQ 分辨率的降质片段。

paragraphs.en: Each LU is trained to map low-resolution degraded latents to their high-resolution degraded counterparts and is used to prepare the input to SR-DiT at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 每个 LU 都被训练用于将低分辨率的退化潜在变量映射到其高分辨率的退化对应物，并在推理阶段用于为 SR-DiT 准备输入。

paragraphs.en: The source videos come from the SR dataset described in Section 2.9 . During dataset preparation, we extract video crops of the required spatial size, filter them, and construct degraded copies. An accepted crop serves as the HQ target, and its degraded counterpart provides the LQ input. Both versions are encoded with K-VAE and stored as paired video latents.
paragraphs.zh: 源视频来自第 2.9 节中描述的 SR 数据集。 在数据集准备过程中，我们提取所需空间尺寸的视频裁剪片段，对其进行过滤，并构建退化副本。 一个合格的裁剪片段用作高清目标，其退化版本则作为低清输入。 两个版本均通过 K-VAE 进行编码，并以成对的视频潜在表示形式存储。

sents.en: The source videos come from the SR dataset described in Section 2.9 .
sents.zh: 源视频来自第 2.9 节中描述的 SR 数据集。

sents.en: During dataset preparation, we extract video crops of the required spatial size, filter them, and construct degraded copies.
sents.zh: 在数据集准备过程中，我们提取所需空间尺寸的视频裁剪片段，对其进行过滤，并构建退化副本。

sents.en: An accepted crop serves as the HQ target, and its degraded counterpart provides the LQ input.
sents.zh: 一个合格的裁剪片段用作高清目标，其退化版本则作为低清输入。

sents.en: Both versions are encoded with K-VAE and stored as paired video latents.
sents.zh: 两个版本均通过 K-VAE 进行编码，并以成对的视频潜在表示形式存储。

paragraphs.en: For the 4K video collection and the Kandinsky 5.0 T2V collection, we extract spatial crops of size 512 × 768 512\times 768 , 512 × 512 512\times 512 , or 768 × 512 768\times 512 pixels (height × \times width), retaining a sequence of frames in each crop. Crop locations are selected using center cropping, random cropping, optical-flow-based selection, or selection of regions with high spatial detail.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 4K 视频集和 Kandinsky 5.0 T2V 集，我们提取尺寸为 512 × 768、512 × 512 或 768 × 512 像素（高度 × 宽度）的空间裁剪区域，并在每个裁剪区域中保留一序列帧。 裁剪位置的选择方式包括中心裁剪、随机裁剪、基于光流的选择，或选择具有较高空间细节的区域。

sents.en: For the 4K video collection and the Kandinsky 5.0 T2V collection, we extract spatial crops of size 512 × 768 512\times 768 , 512 × 512 512\times 512 , or 768 × 512 768\times 512 pixels (height × \times width), retaining a sequence of frames in each crop.
sents.zh: 对于 4K 视频集和 Kandinsky 5.0 T2V 集，我们提取尺寸为 512 × 768、512 × 512 或 768 × 512 像素（高度 × 宽度）的空间裁剪区域，并在每个裁剪区域中保留一序列帧。

sents.en: Crop locations are selected using center cropping, random cropping, optical-flow-based selection, or selection of regions with high spatial detail.
sents.zh: 裁剪位置的选择方式包括中心裁剪、随机裁剪、基于光流的选择，或选择具有较高空间细节的区域。

paragraphs.en: During data preparation, dark borders are excluded from the region available for cropping. Candidate video crops are checked for excessive dark content, visible banding, and compression artifacts using spatial and temporal quality measures. The crop-selection methods are tried in a randomly sampled order, weighted by their configured probabilities. The first candidate that passes all checks is retained; videos for which no candidate passes are skipped. These crop-level checks complement the dataset-level quality filtering described in Section 2.9 . We use two degradation pipelines to construct LQ counterparts from the accepted HQ crops.
paragraphs.zh: 在数据准备过程中，暗色边框会被排除在可用裁剪区域之外。 候选视频裁剪片段会通过空间和时间质量指标，检查是否存在过度暗色内容、可见的色带以及压缩伪影。 裁剪选择方法会按照随机采样的顺序进行尝试，并根据其配置的概率进行加权。 第一个通过所有检查的候选片段将被保留；若某个视频没有任何候选片段通过检查，则会被跳过。 这些裁剪级别的检查是对第 2.9 节中描述的数据集级别质量过滤的补充。 我们使用两种退化处理流程，从已接受的高清裁剪片段中构建低质量对应版本。

sents.en: During data preparation, dark borders are excluded from the region available for cropping.
sents.zh: 在数据准备过程中，暗色边框会被排除在可用裁剪区域之外。

sents.en: Candidate video crops are checked for excessive dark content, visible banding, and compression artifacts using spatial and temporal quality measures.
sents.zh: 候选视频裁剪片段会通过空间和时间质量指标，检查是否存在过度暗色内容、可见的色带以及压缩伪影。

sents.en: The crop-selection methods are tried in a randomly sampled order, weighted by their configured probabilities.
sents.zh: 裁剪选择方法会按照随机采样的顺序进行尝试，并根据其配置的概率进行加权。

sents.en: The first candidate that passes all checks is retained; videos for which no candidate passes are skipped.
sents.zh: 第一个通过所有检查的候选片段将被保留；若某个视频没有任何候选片段通过检查，则会被跳过。

sents.en: These crop-level checks complement the dataset-level quality filtering described in Section 2.9 .
sents.zh: 这些裁剪级别的检查是对第 2.9 节中描述的数据集级别质量过滤的补充。

sents.en: We use two degradation pipelines to construct LQ counterparts from the accepted HQ crops.
sents.zh: 我们使用两种退化处理流程，从已接受的高清裁剪片段中构建低质量对应版本。

paragraphs.en: We use a video adaptation of the two-stage high-order degradation scheme of Real-ESRGAN [ 62 ] . The first stage applies blur, resizing, Gaussian or Poisson noise, JPEG compression, and video compression. The second stage repeats blur, resizing, noise, and JPEG compression, with weaker blur and noise settings. A final block applies video compression and resizing to the target low-resolution size followed by optional sinc filtering; the order of these two components is randomized.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 Real-ESRGAN [62] 的两阶段高阶退化方案的视频改编版本。 第一阶段应用了模糊、调整大小、高斯或泊松噪声、JPEG 压缩和视频压缩。 第二阶段重复了模糊、调整大小、噪声和 JPEG 压缩，但模糊和噪声的设置更弱。 最后一个模块对目标低分辨率尺寸应用视频压缩和调整大小，随后进行可选的 sinc 滤波；这两个组件的顺序是随机化的。

sents.en: We use a video adaptation of the two-stage high-order degradation scheme of Real-ESRGAN [ 62 ] .
sents.zh: 我们使用了 Real-ESRGAN [62] 的两阶段高阶退化方案的视频改编版本。

sents.en: The first stage applies blur, resizing, Gaussian or Poisson noise, JPEG compression, and video compression.
sents.zh: 第一阶段应用了模糊、调整大小、高斯或泊松噪声、JPEG 压缩和视频压缩。

sents.en: The second stage repeats blur, resizing, noise, and JPEG compression, with weaker blur and noise settings.
sents.zh: 第二阶段重复了模糊、调整大小、噪声和 JPEG 压缩，但模糊和噪声的设置更弱。

sents.en: A final block applies video compression and resizing to the target low-resolution size followed by optional sinc filtering; the order of these two components is randomized.
sents.zh: 最后一个模块对目标低分辨率尺寸应用视频压缩和调整大小，随后进行可选的 sinc 滤波；这两个组件的顺序是随机化的。

paragraphs.en: Blur and resize parameters and noise strength are shared across frames, while noise is sampled independently per frame and JPEG quality varies gradually along the video. This pipeline degrades image quality without explicitly warping geometry or changing the frame sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 模糊与缩放参数以及噪声强度在所有帧中共享，而噪声则按帧独立采样，JPEG 画质沿视频逐渐变化。 该流程在不显式扭曲几何结构或改变帧序列的情况下降低了图像质量。

sents.en: Blur and resize parameters and noise strength are shared across frames, while noise is sampled independently per frame and JPEG quality varies gradually along the video.
sents.zh: 模糊与缩放参数以及噪声强度在所有帧中共享，而噪声则按帧独立采样，JPEG 画质沿视频逐渐变化。

sents.en: This pipeline degrades image quality without explicitly warping geometry or changing the frame sequence.
sents.zh: 该流程在不显式扭曲几何结构或改变帧序列的情况下降低了图像质量。

paragraphs.en: The target low-resolution dimensions correspond to a downscaling factor of 2 or 4 along each spatial axis, depending on the encoding configuration. For SR-DiT training, it is bilinearly upsampled back to the HQ dimensions before K-VAE encoding. The low-resolution version is also encoded and stored for LU training.
paragraphs.zh: 目标低分辨率维度对应于每个空间轴上 2 或 4 的下采样因子，具体取决于编码配置。 对于 SR-DiT 训练，在 K-VAE 编码之前，会通过双线性插值将其上采样回高分辨率维度。 低分辨率版本也会被编码并存储用于 LU 训练。

sents.en: The target low-resolution dimensions correspond to a downscaling factor of 2 or 4 along each spatial axis, depending on the encoding configuration.
sents.zh: 目标低分辨率维度对应于每个空间轴上 2 或 4 的下采样因子，具体取决于编码配置。

sents.en: For SR-DiT training, it is bilinearly upsampled back to the HQ dimensions before K-VAE encoding.
sents.zh: 对于 SR-DiT 训练，在 K-VAE 编码之前，会通过双线性插值将其上采样回高分辨率维度。

sents.en: The low-resolution version is also encoded and stored for LU training.
sents.zh: 低分辨率版本也会被编码并存储用于 LU 训练。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by CreativeVR [ 63 ] , this pipeline simulates structural and temporal artifacts in generated video. We use the strong preset of our implementation. A spatial grid warp is applied first, with a displacement field interpolated between two randomly sampled grids over time. Next, three or four operators are selected and applied in random order: directional motion blur, adjacent-frame blending, stochastic frame dropping with interpolation, and spatio-temporal downsampling followed by reconstruction to the original frame count and spatial size. Motion-blur parameters and blending coefficients follow smooth temporal trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 受 CreativeVR [ 63 ] 的启发，该流程模拟了生成视频中的结构性和时间性伪影。 我们使用了实现中的强预设。 首先应用空间网格扭曲，其位移场通过时间维度在两个随机采样的网格之间进行插值。 接下来，选择三到四个算子并以随机顺序应用：方向性运动模糊、相邻帧混合、带插值的随机帧丢弃，以及时空下采样后重建至原始帧数和空间尺寸。 运动模糊参数和混合系数遵循平滑的时间轨迹。

sents.en: We use the strong preset of our implementation.
sents.zh: 我们使用了实现中的强预设。

sents.en: Motion-blur parameters and blending coefficients follow smooth temporal trajectories.
sents.zh: 运动模糊参数和混合系数遵循平滑的时间轨迹。

This full-resolution degraded version is encoded directly for SR-DiT training. A separate low-resolution version is obtained by bilinear downsampling by a factor of 2 or 4 and encoded for LU training.

paragraphs.en: A High-Frequency Perception (HFP) loss adapted from [ 65 ] : L1 between the high-frequency Haar subbands (LH, HL, HH) of the reconstruction and target, with a shared random spatial shift of 0 or 1 pixel along each axis. Its weight is 1.0.
paragraphs.zh: 一种源自 [65] 的高频感知（High-Frequency Perception，HFP）损失函数：在重建结果与目标图像的高频哈尔子带（LH、HL、HH）之间计算 L1 损失，并在每个轴向上共享一个随机空间偏移量（0 或 1 像素）。其权重为 1.0。

paragraphs.en: A masked Fourier space (MFS) loss adapted from [ 66 ] : L1 between FFT amplitudes at the harmonic bins of a 16-pixel grid, matching the spatial compression factor of K-VAE. Its weight is 1.0.
paragraphs.zh: 一种源自 [66] 的掩码傅里叶空间（MFS）损失：在 16 像素网格的谐波分桶处的 FFT 振幅之间计算 L1 损失，以匹配 K-VAE 的空间压缩因子。其权重为 1.0。

paragraphs.en: In the first two training stages, the anchor and its mask are jointly zeroed with probability 0.15, allowing the model to learn restoration without anchor conditioning. The current inference pipeline uses zero anchor and mask inputs. The conditioning interface also allows a future inference variant to supply an HQ first-frame reference, for example using an image super-resolution model.
paragraphs.zh: 在最初的两个训练阶段中，锚点及其掩码会以 0.15 的概率被联合置零，使模型能够在没有锚点条件约束的情况下学习恢复。 当前的推理流程使用零锚点和零掩码输入。 该条件接口还支持未来的一种推理变体，通过提供高分辨率的首帧参考来使用，例如利用图像超分辨率模型。

paragraphs.en: The SR-DiT is trained in three stages on 8 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. All stages use AdamW with β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} , gradient clipping at 1.0, and an LQ noise fraction of s = 0.7 s=0.7 . The × 4 \times 4 and × 2 \times 2 pair sets are sampled with equal probability, with source sequences of 20–31 latent frames. Each GPU processes a packed batch of 124 latent frames, equivalent to four 31-frame clips. Stage 3 additionally accumulates gradients over two microbatches.
paragraphs.zh: SR-DiT 在 8 块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上分三个阶段进行训练。 所有阶段均使用 AdamW，其中 β = (0.9, 0.95)，权重衰减为 10^{-3}，梯度裁剪阈值为 1.0，LQ 噪声比例为 s = 0.7。 ×4 和 ×2 的成对数据集以等概率采样，源序列包含 20–31 个潜在帧。 每块 GPU 处理一个包含 124 个潜在帧的打包批次，相当于四个 31 帧的视频片段。 阶段 3 还会在两个微批次上对梯度进行累积。

sents.en: All stages use AdamW with β = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) \beta=(0.9,0.95) , weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} , gradient clipping at 1.0, and an LQ noise fraction of s = 0.7 s=0.7 .
sents.zh: 所有阶段均使用 AdamW，其中 β = (0.9, 0.95)，权重衰减为 10^{-3}，梯度裁剪阈值为 1.0，LQ 噪声比例为 s = 0.7。

sents.en: The × 4 \times 4 and × 2 \times 2 pair sets are sampled with equal probability, with source sequences of 20–31 latent frames.
sents.zh: ×4 和 ×2 的成对数据集以等概率采样，源序列包含 20–31 个潜在帧。

sents.en: Each GPU processes a packed batch of 124 latent frames, equivalent to four 31-frame clips.

sents.en: Stage 3 additionally accumulates gradients over two microbatches.
sents.zh: 阶段 3 还会在两个微批次上对梯度进行累积。

paragraphs.en: The SR-DiT is initialized from the text-free Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite (SFT) checkpoint and trained with dense attention. We use a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} with 500 warmup steps, EMA decay 0.999, and timestep scheduler scale 5.0. The checkpoint at step 7,250 is used to initialize Stage 2. This stage takes approximately 4.5 days.
paragraphs.zh: SR-DiT 基于无文本的 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite (SFT) 检查点进行初始化，并通过密集注意力机制进行训练。 我们使用学习率 10^{-5}、500 个预热步数、EMA 衰减值 0.999 以及时间步调度器比例 5.0。 第 7,250 步的检查点用于初始化阶段 2。 该阶段大约需要 4.5 天。

sents.en: The SR-DiT is initialized from the text-free Kandinsky 5.0 Video Lite (SFT) checkpoint and trained with dense attention.

sents.en: We use a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} with 500 warmup steps, EMA decay 0.999, and timestep scheduler scale 5.0.
sents.zh: 我们使用学习率 10^{-5}、500 个预热步数、EMA 衰减值 0.999 以及时间步调度器比例 5.0。

sents.en: The checkpoint at step 7,250 is used to initialize Stage 2.
sents.zh: 第 7,250 步的检查点用于初始化阶段 2。

sents.zh: 该阶段大约需要 4.5 天。

paragraphs.en: To reduce attention cost, dense attention is replaced with sparse NABLA attention [ 12 ] . We use top-CDF block selection with P = 0.8 P=0.8 , linearly annealed from 0.95 over the first 200 steps. This is combined with a local neighborhood following sliding-tile attention (STA) [ 67 ] , with a window of 11 × 7 × 7 11\times 7\times 7 attention blocks along time, height, and width. Each spatial block contains 8 × 8 8\times 8 latent tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 为降低注意力成本，我们用稀疏 NABLA 注意力 [ 12 ] 替代了密集注意力。 我们采用 P = 0.8 的 top-CDF 块选择策略，并在前 200 步内从 0.95 线性退火。 这一方法还与局部邻域滑动瓦片注意力（STA）[ 67 ] 相结合，在时间、高度和宽度方向上各使用一个 11 × 7 × 7 的注意力块窗口。 每个空间块包含 8 × 8 个潜在令牌。

sents.en: This is combined with a local neighborhood following sliding-tile attention (STA) [ 67 ] , with a window of 11 × 7 × 7 11\times 7\times 7 attention blocks along time, height, and width.
